<b>\*\*\* Squeak 6.1 &quot;Vanessa&quot; Release Notes \*\*\*</b>

As Squeak approaches its 30th anniversary, we are proud to announce the next version of the system, Squeak 6.1. Some highlights of this release are:
- A new <a href="code://TreeBrowser fullOnClass: Object">tree browser</a>, which enables navigation through classes and categories using refurbished hierarchical morphs,
- The return of <a href="code://ObjectlandMorph openObjectland">Objectland</a> (also known as the &quot;Worlds of Squeak&quot;),
- Several changes and fixes for the kernel infrastructure for simulating, unwinding, and scheduling processes and reshaping classes,
- Miscellaneous improvements and additions to the toolset and user interface for inspecting, debugging, profiling, and versioning code.  

Please find below a detailed listing of all the changes, which includes notes on <b>Major Deprecations</b>, <b>Known Issues</b>, and <b>Compatibility Notes</b> at the bottom.

<b>About these release notes.</b> Phew, what a release! Since the last release <i>4 years ago</i>, we have merged <i>1700+ patches</i> with <i>9000+ method changes</i>. Beyond documenting technical changes in detail, these notes highlight the bigger picture and the overall impact of major developments. Along the way, you will find plenty of links to <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes class&gt;&gt;#v61">code pointers</a> and <a href="code://&#13;(Smalltalk isLowerPerformance or: [SqueakReleaseNotes doABarrelRoll isNil])&#13;	ifTrue: [self inform: &apos;Hello world!&apos;].&#13;self flag: #doNotAssert.">interactive examples</a>. Thus, these release notes serve not only as a changelog but also as a hands-on guide to exploring new features and mechanisms in Squeak. <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes viewOutline">Click here</a> to view an outline of this document.

In memory of Vanessa Freudenberg (1972-2025).

<b>Detailed Improvements in Language, Tools, and the Environment</b>


<b><font color="#808080">~~~ GUI Frameworks ~~~</font></b>

<i>Morphic (up to </i>Morphic-ct.2218/MorphicTests-ct.97<i>)</i>
- <b>Major overhaul of </b><a href="code://(ObjectExplorer openOn: World) extent: 500px@300px"><b>tree morphs</b></a><b>:</b>
  - Improves colors and <a href="code://((((HelpBrowser openOn: SqueakTutorialsCommandKey) model showFirstTopic; anyTextPaneWithSelector: #topicContents) update: #inputRequested with: #topicContents; textMorph) editor setSearch: &apos;Trees\&apos; withCRs; findAgainNow; morph) editView scrollSelectionIntoView">mouse and keyboard shortcuts</a> for navigating trees.
  - Revises <i>type-to-filter</i> similar to lists, highlights search terms, and enables searching single columns via [TAB]. Adds a <a href="code://PluggableTreeMorph&gt;&gt;#filterMode:">configurable filter mode</a> to search within the current selection, all visible nodes, or the entire tree.
  - Introduces a recursive &quot;find&quot;/&quot;find again&quot; feature available via [CMD] + [F]/[CMD] + [G].
  - Adds a <a href="code://SimpleHierarchicalListMorph&gt;&gt;#autoExpand:">flag</a> for automatic expansion of trees.
  - Improves support for <i>drag&apos;n&apos;drop</i> by automatically expanding nodes during dragging after one second of hovering.
  - Miscellaneous stability and performance improvements for layouting, rendering, and event handling in trees.
- In the world, supports dropping of <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes grabTransferMorphFor: Fraction type: #sourceCode from: self">class references</a>, <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes grabTransferMorphFor: Smalltalk environment -&gt; #&apos;Kernel-Numbers&apos; type: #sourceCode from: self">system</a> and <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes grabTransferMorphFor: Fraction -&gt; &apos;printing&apos; type: #sourceCode from: self">method categories</a>, and <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes grabTransferMorphFor: ((Inspector on: self currentHand) fields detect: [:ea | ea name = &apos;bounds&apos;]) type: #inspectorField from: self">inspector</a> and <a href="code://| explorer |&#13;explorer := ObjectExplorer explore: Project current world.&#13;explorer currentParent: explorer root; currentSelection: ((explorer rootObject explorerContents detect: [:ea | ea itemName = &apos;submorphs&apos;])) item.&#13;SqueakReleaseNotes grabTransferMorphFor: explorer currentSelection type: #explorerField from: ((ToolBuilder build: explorer) findA: PluggableTreeMorph)">explorer fields</a> to display them in a new window/widget.
- For mouse interactions, adds new preferences to customize the <a href="code://(Preferences pragmaPreferenceFor: HandMorph getter: #doubleClickTime) open">double-click time</a> and <a href="code://(Preferences pragmaPreferenceFor: HandMorph getter: #dragThreshold) open">drag thresholds</a>.
- In the <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openDockingBarMenuThat: [:m | m contents = &apos;Windows&apos;] filterItem: nil">docking bar window menu</a>, adds an item to collapse windows. Makes <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openDockingBarMenuThat: [:m | m contents = &apos;Windows&apos;] filterItem: &apos;find workspace&apos;">&quot;find workspace&quot;</a> easier to use by expanding the selected window if collapsed. Reorders and decorates items in the <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openDockingBarMenuThat: [:m | m contents = &apos;Help&apos;] filterItem: nil">help menu</a>.
- Text editors:
  - Underlines <a href="code://(Project uiManager chooseOptionFromLabeledValues: (OrderedDictionary new&#13;	at: &apos;OMG, yes!&apos; put: [HelpBrowser open model selectTopicLikePath: {SqueakHelp asHelpTopic. SqueakTutorials asHelpTopic. SqueakTutorials asHelpTopic subtopicAt: #textLinks}];&#13;	at: &apos;Uhm, let me reconsider&apos; put: nil;&#13;	yourself) title: &apos;Yes, this is a link. You just clicked it successfully!&#13;&#13;Do you want to build your own link now?&apos;) value">links (like this one!)</a> during hovering and makes clicking and text selection through them more convenient.
  - When <a href="code://(Preferences pragmaPreferenceFor: TextEditor getter: #encloseSelection) open">enclosing/unenclosing</a> a selection in single/double quotes, nested quotes are now automatically escaped/unescaped.
- Morphic API: Allows morphs to <a href="code://Morph&gt;&gt;#wantsHaloFromClickEvent:">opt out of individual halo events</a> and to specify a balloon text via a <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseAllCallsOn: #balloonTextBlock">block</a> instead of a selector.
- Menu construction:
  - Adds new utilities for adding <a href="code://MenuMorph&gt;&gt;#addGroup:">item groups</a> and <a href="code://MenuMorph&gt;&gt;#withTarget:do:">temporarily switching action targets</a> during construction.
  - <a href="code://MenuMorph&gt;&gt;#addList:">\#addList:</a> now interprets backslashes in help tuples as line breaks.
  - Automatically trims trailing lines between menu items.
- Revises the debug menus of several morphs by adding a <a href="code://| window |&#13;Smalltalk isMorphic ifFalse: [^ self inform: &apos;Can only demonstrate this in Morphic&apos;].&#13;self inform: &apos;A system browser will open now.&lt;br&gt;&#13;From the &lt;b&gt;halo&lt;/b&gt; of one of the buttons, press the &lt;b&gt;wrench icon&lt;/b&gt; on the right to open the &lt;i&gt;debug menu&lt;/i&gt; and choose &lt;b&gt;&quot;spy on action invocation&quot;&lt;/b&gt;.&apos; asTextFromHtml.&#13;window := (Morph&gt;&gt;#addAllMorphs:) browse containingWindow.&#13;(window findDeepSubmorphThat: [:m | (m isKindOf: PluggableButtonMorph) and: [m label = &apos;versions&apos; translated]] ifAbsent: [nil]) addHalo">time-profiler shortcut for buttons</a>, providing access to the list and <a href="code://| window |&#13;Smalltalk isMorphic ifFalse: [^ self inform: &apos;Can only demonstrate this in Morphic&apos;].&#13;window := (SystemWindow windowsIn: Project current world satisfying: [:m | m model isKindOf: HelpBrowser])&#13;	at: 1 ifAbsent: [^ self inform: &apos;No open help browser found&apos;].&#13;self inform: &apos;A halo on the tree morph in this window will open now.&#13;Press the &lt;b&gt;wrench icon&lt;/b&gt; on the right to open the &lt;i&gt;debug menu&lt;/i&gt; and choose &lt;b&gt;&quot;browse get-roots code&quot;&lt;/b&gt; or &lt;b&gt;&quot;debug get-roots invocation&quot;&lt;/b&gt;.&lt;br&gt;&#13;&lt;br&gt;&#13;(Tip: You can also open a halo on an individual tree node to explore its get-children logic in a similar way.)&apos; asTextFromHtml.&#13;(window findDeepSubmorphThat: [:m | m isKindOf: PluggableTreeMorph] ifAbsent: [nil]) addHalo">tree contents</a>, and making existing &quot;browse action&quot; and &quot;debug action&quot; commands faster and more reliable.
- Honors the preference <a href="code://(Preferences pragmaPreferenceFor: UIManager getter: #openToolsAttachedToMouseCursor) open">&quot;Open Tools Attached to Mouse Cursor&quot;</a> in <a href="code://Morph&gt;&gt;#openAsTool">Morph&gt;&gt;openAsTool</a>.
- Lots of UI tweaks and stability improvements:
  - Improves <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openDockingBarMenuThat: [:m | m contents = &apos;Extras&apos;] filterItem: &apos;theme&apos;">theme</a> support for <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes exampleProgressThemes.&#13;self flag: #doNotTest.">progress bars</a>, text morph menus, and dialog windows.
  - Improves <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openDockingBarMenuThat: [:m | m contents = &apos;Extras&apos;] filterItem: &apos;scale&apos;">high-DPI</a> support for buttons, scroll panes, sliders, menus, multi-selection lists, trees, drop-shadows, the scratch pad, the keyboard exerciser, and others.
  - Improves <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseAllCallsOn: #translated">multilingual support</a> in different places.
  - Fixes slips regarding the <a href="code://TheWorldMenu new setDisplayDepth.&#13;self flag: #doNotTest &quot;modal&quot;">world display depth menu</a>, <a href="code://&#13;(World findDeeplyA: ClockMorph)&#13;	ifNil: [^ClockMorph]&#13;	ifNotNil: [:c | c inspect; addHalo]">clock</a> configuration changes, <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes exampleSearchBarPrintIt">search-bar print-its</a>, <a href="code://ProjectViewMorph">project view morph</a> styling, and <a href="code://3 timesRepeat: [Transcript open]">transcript counting</a>.
  - <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openMonticelloVersion: &apos;Morphic-mt.2217&apos;">Fixes</a> an issue when profiling code where user events were swallowed.
  - Several layouting fixes regarding <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openMonticelloVersion: &apos;Morphic-mt.2018&apos;">proportional layouts</a>, <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;TextMorph minHeight&apos; &apos;TextMorph minWidth&apos; &apos;TextMorph doLayoutIn:&apos; &apos;TextMorph addCustomMenuItems:hand:&apos;) name: &apos;TextMorph layout fixes&apos;">text morphs</a>, <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openMonticelloVersion: &apos;Morphic-mt.2129&apos;">scroll panes</a>, and <a href="code://TransformationMorph&gt;&gt;#extent:">transformation morphs</a>.
  - Fixes rendering issues with <a href="code://ToolSet browseMethodVersion: TransformMorph&gt;&gt;#invalidRect:from:">transform morphs</a>, <a href="code://ToolSet browseMethodVersion: PolygonMorph&gt;&gt;#computeBounds">polygons</a>, multi-selection lists, and trees.
  - Fixes scrolling in <a href="code://ScrollPane exampleNested">nested scroll panes</a>.
  - In text morphs, improves stability of text selection and tweaks indentation regarding empty and blank lines.
  - Fixes <a href="code://TextEditor&gt;&gt;#sendersOfIt">&quot;browse senders&quot;</a> of true, false, and nil, adds missing <a href="code://PluggableTextMorph&gt;&gt;#bindingOf:">access to workspace bindings</a> during accept-its, and improves robustness of <a href="code://TextEditor&gt;&gt;#closeTypeIn">editor history</a>.
  - Fixes bugs in construction of <a href="code://TextContainer">text containers</a> and <a href="code://NewParagraph&gt;&gt;#asText">conversion of paragraphs</a> to texts.
  - In lists, fixes automatic selection before dragging an item.
  - Fixes incorrect yellow-button menu invocation on buttons and lists.
  - Fixes a bug during menu construction, which depended on <a href="code://MenuMorph&gt;&gt;#addAllFrom:">uninitialized state</a>.
  - Fixes scaling of <a href="code://ColorForm">color forms</a>.
  - Fixes <a href="code://Morph&gt;&gt;#showActions">introspection of event handlers</a> in morph meta-menus.
  - Improves <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;BalloonMorph text&apos; &apos;BalloonMorph setText:&apos;) name: &apos;NewBalloonMorph compatibility&apos;">compatibility</a> between <a href="code://BalloonMorph">old</a> <a href="code://(Preferences pragmaPreferenceFor: NewBalloonMorph getter: #useNewBalloonMorph) open">and</a> <a href="code://NewBalloonMorph">new balloon morphs</a>.
  - Fixes a <a href="https://lists.squeakfoundation.org/archives/list/squeak-dev%40lists.squeakfoundation.org/thread/RNK3IM45WLMN5QVY3J3FFUEMPZYZNMS5/">remarkable slip</a> that (1) prevented collapsed windows from applying a new UI theme and (2) introduced a possibly significant memory leak of windows.
  - Fixes <a href="https://github.com/squeak-smalltalk/squeak-object-memory/issues/20">an issue on macOS</a> where calling the VM with additional command line arguments or plugging in external devices led to an incorrect &quot;The VM is configured as a singleton application&quot; warning.
  - Improves stability and backward compatibility when <a href="code://BorderedMorph&gt;&gt;#readDataFrom:size:">loading</a> morphs from files.
  - Fixes cross-compatibility and concurrency issues with <a href="code://MVCProject new enter.&#13;self flag: #doNotTest">MVC</a>.
  - Improves reliability of halos.
- Improves performance of large tree widgets, <a href="code://TransformationMorph&gt;&gt;#extent:">transformation morphs</a>, and <a href="code://AnimatedImageMorph&gt;&gt;#step">animated GIFs</a>.
- Miscellaneous clean-ups and documentation improvements for <a href="code://UserInputEvent">input events</a>, editor attributes, and others.

<i>MorphicExtras (up to </i>MorphicExtras-ct.360<i>)</i>
- <b>Introduces </b><a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openDockingBarMenuThat: [:m | m contents = &apos;Apps&apos;] filterItem: &apos;Objectland&apos;"><b>Objectland</b></a><b>, which is a reconstruction of the famous &quot;Worlds of Squeak&quot; from 2003</b> and offers a colorful collection of examples that demonstrate the multifarious capabilities of Squeak. Re-adds the classic <a href="code://(HelpBrowser open) model rootTopic: SqueakTutorials asHelpTopic; selectTopicLikePath: {SqueakTutorialsEToys asHelpTopic. SqueakTutorialsEToys makingAnEtoy}.&#13;self flag: #workaround. &quot;no #openOn: because help browser commits to horizontal scroll bars initially&quot;">Etoys race car example</a> and adds several new examples.
- After 18 years of spotless, clean Squeak, reintroduces and updates the famous <a href="code://BlobMorph new openInHand">BlobMorph</a>.
- For <a href="code://WebCamMorph new openInHand">webcams</a>, adds a mirror option and extends interface for double-buffering. Improves UI and stability of webcam morph.
- Improves instrument menu of <a href="code://ScorePlayerMorph extraExample openInHand">score players</a>.
- Fixes the <a href="code://(Preferences pragmaPreferenceFor: TrashCanMorph getter: #preserveTrash) open">&quot;preserve trash&quot;</a> preference and improves the robustness of the <a href="code://PianoKeyboardMorph new openInWorld">piano keyboard</a>.
- Improves high-DPI support for the <a href="code://Project current world activateObjectsTool">objects tool</a>, several of its tools such as <a href="code://EventRecorderMorph new openInWorld">event recorders</a>, <a href="code://ScorePlayerMorph extraExample openInHand">score players</a>, <a href="code://RecordingControlsMorph new openInWorld">recording controls</a>, and <a href="code://PianoKeyboardMorph new openInWorld">piano keyboards</a>, and several EToys-related morphs.

<i>Etoys (up to </i>EToys-ct.532<i>)</i>
- Restores and revises a <a href="code://HelpBrowser openOn: SqueakTutorialsEToys">tutorial on painting and creating scripts in Etoys</a>.
- Adds an undo button to <a href="code://FreeCell new openInWorld">FreeCell</a>.
- Improves state indication in <a href="code://Tetris new openInWorld">Tetris</a>.
- Improves instrument menu of the <a href="code://MidiInputMorph new openInWorld">midi input morph</a>.
- Improves robustness of the <a href="code://World galleryOfPlayers">players gallery</a>, the <a href="code://SpectrumAnalyzerMorph new openInWorld">spectrum analyzer</a>, and the <a href="code://MidiInputMorph new openInWorld ">midi input morph</a>. Fixes changing the heading of a player.
- Clean-ups and fixes for cards and stacks.
- Improves high-DPI support for Etoys icons, tile morphs and script editors, <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes browseGames">all games</a>, the <a href="code://Project current world activateObjectsTool">objects tool</a>, the <a href="code://SpectrumAnalyzerMorph new openInWorld">spectrum analyzer</a>, file lists, <a href="code://WatchMorph new openInHand">watches</a>, and <a href="code://CalendarMorph new openInHand">calendars</a>.
- Minor speedups for Kedama and players.
- Several clean-ups and refactorings that improve overall modularity and avoid unintended dependencies of other packages on Etoys.

<i>ST80 (up to </i>ST80-mt.311<i>)</i>
- Adds a close item to the <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes exampleMVCProjectScreenMenu.&#13;self flag: #doNotTest.">world menu</a>.
- Improves high-DPI support for system views.
- Adds <a href="code://View&gt;&gt;#imageForm">View&gt;&gt;imageForm</a> for taking a screenshot of a view and displays it in inspectors.
- Adds editor shortcut [CMD] + [SHIFT] + [D] for &quot;debug it&quot; (already exists in Morphic).
- Miscellaneous fixes and stability improvements:
  - Ensures confirmation dialog before closing the current MVC project.
  - Prevents unexpected author-initials dialog when opening the ST80 world menu for the first time.
  - Avoids an issue with stale deferred actions in an empty MVC world, which caused emergency debuggers to appear only after pressing a mouse button.
  - In text editors, fixes pretty-printing and spawning if no compatible model is available. Gently handles nil selection provided by the model. Fixes an issue with recently introduced keyboard shortcuts.
  - Repairs <a href="code://MVCProject&gt;&gt;#findAFolderForProject:label:">folder choosers</a>.

<i>CommandLine (up to </i>CommandLine-eem.27<i>)</i>
- Repairs the preference <a href="code://(Preferences pragmaPreferenceFor: CommandLineToolSet getter: #saveSnapshotOnError) open">&quot;Save snapshot of image on failure&quot;</a>.
- Improves <a href="code://DummyUIManager">UIManager support</a> for various file dialogs, font dialogs, confirmations, and requests.
- For interactive dialog requests, improves the error message before quitting.


<b><font color="#808080">~~~ Programming &amp; Tools ~~~</font></b>

<i>Tools (up to </i>Tools-mt.1366/ToolsTests-ct.137<i>)</i>
- <b>Introduces a new </b><a href="code://TreeBrowser fullOnClass: Object"><b>tree browser</b></a>, which displays system categories, classes, and message categories in hierarchical panes and integrates Monticello packages. There are also <a href="code://PreferenceBrowser open searchPattern: #TreeBrowser; changed: #searchPatternNeverTriggered">five new preferences</a> for configuring its appearance.
  - <b>Reworks </b><b><i>drag&apos;n&apos;drop</i></b> for tree browsers and traditional browsers to support <a href="code://&#13;&apos;Possible drag&apos;&apos;n&apos;&apos;drop operations you can try out in system browsers:&#13;* Drag methods or method categories onto a class to move or copy them there (previously, you could only drop a method onto a message category in a second browser).&#13;* In tree browsers, drag a category onto another category to insert it as a child category.&#13;* In tree browsers, when renaming or moving a category, have all its children automatically renamed/moved as well (holds up the tree browser&apos;&apos;s files-and-folders metaphor).&#13;* Also in tree browsers, shift-drag a class onto a system category to copy it.&#13;* Drag a class onto another class to change its superclass.&#13;* Drag a category onto -- all -- to dissolve it (i.e., unclassify all its elements).&#13;* Move or copy classes and system categories between different environments.&#13;* When renaming a system category, a dialog will offer you to recategorize any extension methods as well.&#13;* Drag method categories or system categories into the world to spawn a new browser on them.&#13;* Drag and drop from/into singleton browsers (that show a single class or category) just like in full browsers.&apos;&#13;edit">all meaningful combinations of panes</a> for copying or moving classes, methods, and categories.
  - Adds double-click support for <a href="code://TreeBrowser fullHierarchyOnClass: Collection">hierarchy tree browsers</a> to switch the central class. This is especially fun for <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes exampleTreeBrowserMultipleInheritanceWithTraits">multi-inheritance hierarchies with traits</a>.
  - In the class pane menu, adds <a href="code:// | browser classList menu |&#13;browser := TreeBrowser fullOnClass: Object.&#13;classList := browser containingWindow findDeepSubmorphThat: [:m | m knownName = #classList] ifAbsent: [^ nil].&#13;classList yellowButtonActivity: false.&#13;menu := self currentWorld findA: MenuMorph.&#13;menu position: classList position + 15 px.&#13;menu checkedMatchString: &apos;new&apos;.">new items</a> for generating a new class or trait.
  - In the message category menu, adds <a href="code:// | browser messageCatList menu |&#13;browser := TreeBrowser fullOnClass: Object category: &apos;accessing&apos;.&#13;messageCatList := browser containingWindow findDeepSubmorphThat: [:m | m knownName = #messageCategoryList] ifAbsent: [^ nil].&#13;messageCatList yellowButtonActivity: false.&#13;menu := self currentWorld findA: MenuMorph.&#13;menu position: messageCatList position + 15 px.&#13;menu checkedMatchString: &apos;browse&apos;.">items</a> to browse all [related] message categories in the system.
  - In the annotation pane of class definitions, adds a <a href="code://((TreeBrowser fullOnClass: Object) containingWindow findDeepSubmorphThat: [:m | m isTextView and: [m getTextSelector = #annotation]] ifAbsent: [^ nil]) addHalo">shortcut</a> for reading the full class comment.
  - Simplifies <a href="code://StandardToolSet class&gt;&gt;#browseHierarchy:selector:">extension point</a> for custom browsers to register as hierarchy browsers.
  - Improves <a href="code://Object newSubclass&#13;	in: [:c | c environment import: Smalltalk environment];&#13;	comment: &apos;I am a uniclass in a custom environment!&apos;;&#13;	browse">multi-environment support</a> for all kinds of browsers and message sets.
- In the Message Names tool, shows the definition, comment, and hierarchy for <a href="code://ToolSet browseMessageNames: &apos;SequenceableCollection&apos;">class results</a>.
- <b>Extends inspector support for custom fields:</b>
  - Allows objects to contribute <b>custom </b><a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openBrowser: (SystemBrowser default fullOnClass: Object selector: #streamInspectorFieldsFor:on:) filterMessages: &apos;inspect&apos;"><b>inspector fields</b></a><b> and </b><a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openBrowser: (SystemBrowser default fullOnClass: Object selector: #addInspectorItemsToMenu:for:) filterMessages: &apos;inspect&apos;"><b>menu items</b></a>.
  - Adds new <a href="code:// | inspector fieldList menu |&#13;inspector := Project current world inspectorClass openOn: Project current world.&#13;inspector model selectFieldNamed: &apos;extent&apos;.&#13;fieldList := inspector findDeepSubmorphThat: [:m | m knownName = #fieldList] ifAbsent: [^ nil].&#13;fieldList yellowButtonActivity: true.&#13;menu := self currentWorld findA: MenuMorph.&#13;menu position: fieldList position + (15 px @ 30 px).">meta (shift) menu</a> to inspect fields or browse/debug their accessors.
  - Adds <a href="code://#printBlock:">InspectorField&gt;&gt;\#printBlock:</a> for customizing the representation of a field independently of its underlying (inspectable) value.
- When <a href="code://| object |&#13;object := Text melvilleSample asString asArray.&#13;(ToolSet inspect: object) model selectFieldNamed: &apos;...&apos;.">inspecting large collections</a>, allows disabling truncation to show all elements.
- Makes <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openMonticelloVersion: &apos;Tools-ct.1313&apos;">inspection</a> and <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openMonticelloVersion: &apos;Tools-ct.1314&apos;">debugging</a> of transparent proxy objects and unhashable objects more reliable by avoiding sending them any messages, to which they might react slowly or catastrophically.
- <b>Debuggers:</b>
  - <b>Adds </b><a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes exampleDebuggerSendUntil"><b>&quot;send until...&quot; command</b></a> to precisely search for a condition in nested message sends.
  - <b>Improves </b><a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes exampleDebuggerRunToHereBlock.&#13;self flag: #doNotTest."><b>&quot;run to here&quot; command</b></a> to reach expressions in blocks.
  - Improves error handling for invalid run until/send until expressions. For <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes exampleDebuggerReturnEnteredValue">&quot;return entered value&quot;</a>, uses the proper evaluatorClass of the receiver.
  - To the stack list menu, adds <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes exampleDebuggerSelectHome.&#13;self flag: #doNotTest.">&quot;select home&quot; option</a> for finding the home contexts of (possibly deeply nested) blocks.
  - <b>Makes the signaled exception and suspended process accessible</b> in the debugger when no context frame is selected. <a href="code://|workspace|&#13;workspace := Project uiManager edit: &apos;1. Run the following do-it via &lt;b&gt;Cmd + P&lt;/b&gt;&lt;br&gt;&#13;2. In the debugger notifier, click on &lt;b&gt;Debug&lt;/b&gt; to open a full debugger&lt;br&gt;&#13;3. Click on the &lt;b&gt;currently selected context frame&lt;/b&gt; again to &lt;b&gt;deselect&lt;/b&gt; it&lt;br&gt;&#13;4. In the text pane, now the &lt;b&gt;&lt;font color=&quot;#008000&quot;&gt;original error message&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/b&gt; is shown!&lt;br&gt;&#13;5. By using the two &lt;b&gt;inspectors&lt;/b&gt; at the bottom, you can also inspect the exception and the suspended process.&lt;br&gt;&#13;6. Alternatively, you can also toggle between the exception/process view and normal stacks via the &lt;b&gt;small window menu icon&lt;/b&gt; at the right top corner of the window.&lt;br&gt;&#13;&lt;br&gt;&#13;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;  |&lt;br&gt;&#13;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;  |&lt;br&gt;&#13;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;  v&lt;br&gt;&#13;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;font color=&quot;#800000&quot;&gt;2&lt;/font&gt;&lt;font color=&quot;#000000&quot;&gt; &lt;/font&gt;&lt;font color=&quot;#000080&quot;&gt;/&lt;/font&gt;&lt;font color=&quot;#000000&quot;&gt; &lt;/font&gt;&lt;font color=&quot;#800000&quot;&gt;0&lt;/font&gt;&apos; asTextFromHtml label: &apos;Tutorial: Viewing exception and process in debugger&apos; shouldStyle: false.&#13;ToolBuilder default class setBoundsForWindow: workspace to: (((ToolBuilder default class getBoundsForWindow: workspace) origin extent: 475px@300px)).">Try it out!</a>
  - <b>Adds a </b><a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes exampleDebuggerByteCodes"><b>byteCodes mode</b></a><b> to the debugger</b> to view and step through the single VM instructions of a method (similar to the byteCodes mode in browsers). Adds a new &quot;simulate&quot; button to debug how Squeak&apos;s metacircular evaluator (aka context simulator) interprets the next bytecode. The new mode is reachable through the window menu &gt; &quot;what to show...&quot;, or, when <a href="code://(Preferences preferenceAt: #extraDebuggerButtons) open">extra debugger buttons</a> are enabled, through the &quot;source&quot; button above the code pane.
  - Miscellaneous clean-ups and improvements for customizing <a href="code://Context&gt;&gt;#contextVariablesInspectorClass">inspector classes</a>.
- <b>Welcomes </b><b><a href="code://TextLink new classAndMethod: &apos;AndreasSystemProfiler Comment&apos;; actOnClickFor: Model new">AndreasSystemProfiler</a></b><b> in the trunk</b>, which was previously hosted in the VMMaker repository. Improves report format, robustness for tallying primitives, and documentation.
- In workspaces, adds a <a href="code://|ws menu|&#13;ws := Project uiManager edit: &apos;In workspaces, adds a &quot;load contents from file...&quot; option to the window menu.&apos; label: &apos;Workspace&apos; shouldStyle: false.&#13;ws offerWindowMenu.&#13;menu := self currentWorld findA: MenuMorph.&#13;ws topRight: menu topLeft + (50 px @ -50 px).&#13;menu checkedMatchString: &apos;load&apos;">&quot;load contents from file...&quot; option</a> to the window menu.
- <b>Improvements to </b><a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openDockingBarMenuThat: [:m | m contents = &apos;Extras&apos;] filterItem: &apos;Recover changes&apos;"><b>change recovery</b></a><b>:</b> Improves parsing of class definitions, method removals, recategorizations, and more. Adds and revises menu items to select all changes of a given type or filter for changes to the currently selected type or selector.
- Adds utilities <a href="code://Process&gt;&gt;#browse">Process&gt;&gt;\#browse</a> and <a href="code://Context&gt;&gt;#tempNamed:">Context&gt;&gt;\#tempNamed:</a>[<a href="code://Context&gt;&gt;#tempNamed:put:">put:</a>].
- Adds <a href="code://ArchiveViewer class&gt;&gt;#fileReaderServicesForFile:suffix:">file services</a> for viewing compressed <code>csz</code> and <code>stz</code> archives.
- In <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes exampleBrowseSourcesFileText">truncated file lists</a>, inserts a link for reading the entire file.
- Improves layout of <a href="code://ByteTextConverter class&gt;&gt;#browseAllCodePoints">code-point browsers for single-byte text-converters</a>.
- Miscellaneous UI improvements and bug fixes:
  - Fixes for browsers:
    - Fixes shortcut inconsistency in single-category browsers.
    - Improves robustness in browsers when defining traits.
    - Fixes a slip in hierarchy browsers that spawned a new redundant browser when redefining the selected class.
    - Fixes <a href="code://PackagePaneBrowser open">package pane browser</a> to actually use the package organizer instead of parsing the system category list. If no category is selected, shows all classes from the package.
    - Deduplicates menus in package pane browsers.
    - Fixes missing UI updates and class-side do-its in package pane browsers and <a href="code://DependencyBrowser open ">dependency browsers</a>.
    - Fixes UI proportions and styling of class definitions and comments in <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes exampleFileContentsBrowser">file contents browsers</a>.
    - Consistently sorts classes in <a href="code://ClassListBrowser example3. nil">class list browsers</a>.
  - Fixes for message traces:
    - Ensures consistent method labels in message traces.
    - Improves robustness and dialogs for browsing senders/implementors.
    - Minor UI string fixes.
  - Fixes for message names:
    - Fixes spawn ([CMD] + [O]) in <a href="code://MessageNames openMessageNames">message names</a>.
  - Improvements for <a href="code://ToolSet browseMethodVersion: VersionsBrowser&gt;&gt;#annotation">versions browsers</a>:
    - Displays the stamp and category of the selected version, rather than always the current version&apos;s.
    - When filing out a method, adds missing file extension.
  - Fixes for <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openDockingBarMenuThat: [:m | m contents = &apos;Extras&apos;] filterItem: &apos;Recover changes&apos;">change lists</a>:
    - Fixes change logging for methods that are recompiled from a browser without its existing category being selected.
    - Improves robustness of recover changes scanning.
    - Improves stability for &quot;remove older method versions&quot;.
  - Fixes for inspectors and explorers:
    - Fixes inspecting of <a href="code://(ToolSet inspect: Form extraWizard) model selectFieldNamed: &apos;pixels&apos;">forms</a> in non-native display depths.
    - Fixes nested temporary variables when <a href="https://lists.squeakfoundation.org/archives/list/squeak-dev@lists.squeakfoundation.org/thread/B2YYJTTCEGOHZXIHOIKEXPTKNC4OM3JR">inspecting blocks</a>.
    - Fixes inspecting dictionaries with <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openMonticelloVersion: &apos;Tools-ct.1365&apos;">non-storable keys</a>.
    - Adds styling of <i>thisContext</i> in context inspectors in debuggers.
    - Fixes shortcut for opening an Etoys viewer ([CMD] + [V]).
    - <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openMonticelloVersion: &apos;Tools-ct.1312&apos;">Improves robustness</a> when exchanging the inspected object in an inspector.
    - Improves robustness of <a href="code://InspectorField class&gt;&gt;#generateExpressionFrom:argumentNames:">&quot;copy expression&quot;</a> for a selected field.
    - Fixes handling of unsaved changes in inspectors and explorers by using new <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;Inspector okToChange:&apos; &apos;ObjectExplorer okToChange:&apos;) name: &apos;okToChange:&apos;">\#okToChange:</a> hook.
    - Harmonizes object explorer labels to match labels in the tree.
  - Fixes for debugger:
    - <a href="code://#stepToStatement">Fixes</a> stepping through abort messages such as <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseAllImplementorsOf: #mustBeBoolean">\#mustBeBoolean</a> and restarting from primitive methods that no longer fail, and updates window label accordingly. Improves <a href="code://{SqueakReleaseNotes openBrowser: (ToolSet browseClass: DebuggerTests) filterMessages: &apos;abort&apos;.&#13;SqueakReleaseNotes openBrowser: (ToolSet browseClass: DebuggerTests) filterMessages: &apos;unexpected&apos;}">tests</a>.
    - Fixes highlighting of next expression for to:do: statements and assignments.
    - Fixes out-of-date context variables after restarting the top context.
    - Fixes regression in runUntil when pressing shift.
    - Fixes &quot;return entered value&quot; to properly detect unhandled errors during unwinding.
    - When recompiling a method in a debugger, allows to proceed despite of no active home method. Fixes bug when recompilation is aborted.
    - Improves stability and up-to-dateness of stack list.
    - Miscellaneous clean-ups.
- Speeds up <a href="code://ProcessBrowser open">process browser</a> for managing <a href="code://ProcessBrowser&gt;&gt;#updateProcessList">very large lists</a> of processes.
- Improves high-DPI support for system browsers and <a href="code://TextLink new classAndMethod: &apos;FileList2 Hierarchy&apos;; actOnClickFor: Model new">FileList2</a>.
- Miscellaneous improvements of multilingual support.
- Significantly improves test coverage of <a href="code://TreeBrowserTest">tree browsers</a> and <a href="code://DebuggerTests">debuggers</a>.

<i>ToolBuilder (up to </i>ToolBuilder-Kernel-ct.176<i>/</i>ToolBuilder-Morphic-ct.370<i>/</i>ToolBuilder-MVC-mt.77<i>/</i>ToolBuilder-Tests-ct.9<i>)</i>
- Adds support for blocks in <a href="code://ToolBuilderSpec&gt;&gt;#help:">ToolBuilderSpec&gt;&gt;help:</a> and <a href="code://PluggableMenuItemSpec&gt;&gt;#action:">PluggableMenuItemSpec&gt;&gt;action:</a>.
- Improves <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes browseSharedProtocolOfAll: {MenuMorph. CustomMenu. PluggableMenuSpec}">compatibility</a> between MenuMorphs, CustomMenus, and PluggableMenuSpec.
- Adds <a href="code://UIManager&gt;&gt;#inform:title:">UIManager&gt;&gt;inform:title:</a> for also providing a title.
- Adds <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openBrowser: (ToolSet browse: UIManager selector: #chooseFileFrom:) filterMessages: &apos;chooseFileFrom:&apos;">UIManager&gt;&gt;chooseFileFrom:[...]</a> for providing a start directory.
- Adds shorthands <a href="code://UIManager&gt;&gt;#chooseFile">UIManager&gt;&gt;chooseFile</a> and <a href="code://UIManager&gt;&gt;#multiLineRequest:">UIManager&gt;&gt;multiLineRequest:</a>[<a href="code://UIManager&gt;&gt;#multiLineRequest:initialAnswer:">initialAnswer:</a>].
- For <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openBrowser: (ToolSet browse: UIManager selector: #informUserDuring:) filterMessages: &apos;informUser&apos;">UIManager&gt;&gt;informUser(</a><a href="code://UIManager&gt;&gt;#informUser:during:">:d</a><a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openBrowser: (ToolSet browse: UIManager selector: #informUserDuring:) filterMessages: &apos;informUser&apos;">\|</a><a href="code://UIManager&gt;&gt;#informUserDuring:">D</a><a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openBrowser: (ToolSet browse: UIManager selector: #informUserDuring:) filterMessages: &apos;informUser&apos;">)uring:</a>, provides optional access to the progress bar inside the provided block and properly returns the result of the block.
- Stops ignoring help texts for checkboxes and menu items.
- Morphic-specific changes:
  - <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openMonticelloVersion: &apos;ToolBuilder-Morphic-ct.320&apos;"><b>Improves</b></a><b> convenience and stability of </b><a href="code://(Project uiManager chooseFileMatchingSuffixes: #(&apos;st&apos; &apos;cs&apos;) label: &apos;Example file chooser&apos;) ifNotNil: #inspect"><b>file</b></a><b> </b><a href="code://&#13;(Project uiManager saveFilenameRequest: &apos;Example save file dialog&apos; initialAnswer: &apos;newName.st&apos;) ifNotNil: #inspect"><b>selection</b></a><b> </b><a href="code://&#13;(Project uiManager chooseDirectory: &apos;Example directory chooser&apos; from: (FileDirectory on: FileDirectory workingDirectory)) ifNotNil: #inspect"><b>dialogs</b></a><b>.</b> All kinds of file dialogs now contain an address bar. Improves handling of extensions, automatic selection by typing into address bar, and handles double-click on a file to confirm the dialog.
  - In <a href="code://#wantsDroppedMorph:event:on:">lists</a> and <a href="code://PluggableTreeMorph&gt;&gt;#wantsDroppedMorph:event:onItem:">trees</a>, allows the model to decide whether it accepts a dropped object <i>based on the hovered item</i>.
  - Adds new model-changed operations for trees to <a href="code://ToolSet browseMethodVersion: PluggableTreeMorph&gt;&gt;#update:with:">expand</a> or <a href="code://ToolSet browseMethodVersion: PluggableTreeMorph&gt;&gt;#update:">update the labels</a> of nodes. Forgives models that do not emit the current path for the current selection but fetches the new path automatically.
  - For tree specs, adds a new <a href="code://PluggableTreeSpec&gt;&gt;#filterMode:">filter mode</a> and <a href="code://PluggableTreeSpec&gt;&gt;#searchMode:">search mode</a>.
  - Fixes <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openMonticelloVersion: &apos;ToolBuilder-Morphic-ct.318&apos;">UI glitches</a> when dynamically updating the children of windows and panels.
  - Clean-ups and deduplications for trees.
- MVC-specific changes:
  - Adds static support for <a href="code://PluggableCompositeSpec&gt;&gt;#children:">children selector</a> in panels analogously to windows (dynamic children updates in MVC are still not supported). Fixes a layout slip for zero children.
  - In <a href="code://MVCToolBuilder&gt;&gt;#open:label:">MVCToolBuilder&gt;&gt;open:label:</a>, adds missing support for view and menu arguments.
  - Fixes UI glitches when closing windows with scroll bars.

<i>SUnit (up to </i>SUnit-mt.153/SUnitGUI-mt.95/SUnitTools-mt.9/ToolBuilder-SUnit-pre.22<i>)</i>
- <b>Indicates </b><a href="code://TestFailure&gt;&gt;#isTimeout"><b>timeouts</b></a> in TestResult and displays them in the <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes exampleTestRunnerTimeout ">test runner</a>.
- Repairs the exclusion of classes via <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;TestRunner excludeClassesNotUnderTestFrom:&apos;) name: &apos;#classNamesNotUnderTest&apos; autoSelect: &apos;classNamesNotUnderTest&apos;">\#classNamesNotUnderTest</a>.
- Fixes test generation for \#// selectors.
- Properly resets <a href="code://TestResult&gt;&gt;#resetUnexpectedPasses">unexpected passes</a> when rerunning failures in test runner.

<i>Nebraska (up to </i>Nebraska-ct.65<i>)</i>
- Adds support for <a href="code://NetworkTerminalMorph&gt;&gt;#handleMouseWheel:">mouse-wheel scrolling</a> in remote terminals.
- Improves reliability of event handling for <a href="code://TextLink new classAndMethod: &apos;NebraskaServer Comment&apos;; actOnClickFor: Model new">remote terminals</a>, making it possible to freely move, resize, and rotate terminals in the client&apos;s world again.
- Fixes default port selection for Nebraska connections.
- Improves error handling for refused peer-to-peer connections.

<i>Protocols (up to </i>Protocols-ct.91<i>)</i>
- Improves high-DPI support for <a href="code://Lexicon browseFullProtocol. nil">lexicons</a>.
- Fixes and cleans up window titles of lexicons.

<i>Services</i>
- No changes.

<i>Shout (Syntax Highlighting) (up to </i>ShoutCore-ct.98/ShoutTests-eem.34<i>)</i>
- <b>Styles comments in </b><i><b>italics</b></i><b> by default</b> and provides a <a href="code://(Preferences pragmaPreferenceFor: SHTextStylerST80 getter: #enforceItalicEmphasisInComments) open">preference</a> for this behavior.
- Fixes parsing of unary selectors beginning and/or ending with <a href="code://(Preferences pragmaPreferenceFor: Scanner getter: #allowUnderscoreAsAssignment) open">underscores</a>.


<b><font color="#808080">~~~ Core Language ~~~</font></b>

<i>Kernel (up to </i>Kernel-ct.1688/KernelTests-ct.482<i>)</i>
- <b>Numbers:</b>
  - Adds new facilities <a href="code:// Complex&gt;&gt;#log">Complex&gt;&gt;log</a>, <a href="code:// Integer&gt;&gt;#bitInvert64">Integer&gt;&gt;bitInvert64</a>, <a href="code:// Integer&gt;&gt;#timesCollect:">Integer&gt;&gt;timesCollect:</a>, <a href="code:// Number&gt;&gt;#timesTwoPower:">Number&gt;&gt;timesTwoPower:</a>, and <a href="code:// ScaledDecimal&gt;&gt;#printFractionAsDecimal">ScaledDecimal&gt;&gt;printFractionAsDecimal</a>.
  - Corrects behavior for <a href="code:// self systemNavigation browseAllImplementorsOf: #sin">\#sin</a>, <a href="code:// self systemNavigation browseAllImplementorsOf: #cos">\#cos</a>, and <a href="code:// self systemNavigation browseAllImplementorsOf: #tan">\#tan</a> for huge integers and fractions.
  - Several fixes for number parsing (<a href="code:// SqNumberParserTest&gt;&gt;#testIntegerWithNegativeExponent">rounding</a> of floats with large negative exponent and no fraction part; parsing of <a href="code://TextLink new classAndMethod: &apos;FORTRANNumberParser Comment&apos;; actOnClickFor: Model new">FORTRAN</a> numbers).
  - Various optimizations for <a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: Integer category: &apos;bit manipulation&apos;">integer bit manipulation</a>, <a href="code:// SqueakReleaseNotes openMonticelloDiffFrom: &apos;Kernel-ct.1549&apos; to: &apos;Kernel-mt.1551&apos;">mixed int-float arithmetic (+ - \*)</a>, <a href="code:// self systemNavigation browseAllImplementorsOf: #asTrueFraction">float-to-fraction conversion</a>, and <a href="code:// self systemNavigation browseAllImplementorsOf: #cos">trigonometric functions</a>.
- Adds support for <b>non-local exits</b> with values through <a href="code:// BlockClosure&gt;&gt;#valueWithExitValue">BlockClosure&gt;&gt;valueWithExitValue</a>.
- <b>Models:</b> Allows <a href="code://Object&gt;&gt;#okToChange:">unsaved changes checks</a> to be scoped to particular views, making it easier in some tools to, for example, select a different list item or open a menu without needing to cancel changes in an editor.
- <b>Debugging utilities:</b> Adds <a href="code:// (MessageTrace openMessageList: #(&apos;Object haltOnceIf:&apos;) name: &apos;Implementors of haltOnceIf:&apos;) model&#13;	addParentMessages: {(ObjectTest&gt;&gt;#testHaltOnceIf) asCodeReference} autoSelectString: #haltOnceIf:.&#13;nil">\#haltOnceIf:</a> as a union of <a href="code:// (MessageTrace openMessageList: #(&apos;Object haltOnceIf:&apos;) name: &apos;Implementors of haltOnce&apos;) model&#13;	addParentMessages: {(ObjectTest&gt;&gt;#testHaltOnceIf) asCodeReference} autoSelectString: #haltOnce.&#13;nil">\#haltOnce</a> and <a href="code:// (MessageTrace openMessageList: #(&apos;Object haltOnceIf:&apos;) name: &apos;Implementors of haltIf:&apos;) model&#13;	addParentMessages: {(ObjectTest&gt;&gt;#testHaltOnceIf) asCodeReference} autoSelectString: #haltIf:.&#13;nil">\#haltIf:</a>. Makes <a href="code:// ToolSet browseHierarchy: ObjectTracer selector: #mustBeBoolean">ObjectTracer</a>/<a href="code:// ToolSet browseHierarchy: ObjectViewer selector: #doesNotUnderstand:">ObjectViewer</a> capable of proxying true/false.
- <b>Debugging &amp; simulation:</b>
  - Fixes various edge cases of the <a href="code:// Context&gt;&gt;#step"><b>context simulator</b></a>, which is used for stepping methods in the debugger. This improves the overall robustness and correctness when debugging the entire system from within itself. Concretely, we revised debugging of <a href="code:// (Process forBlock: [2 withArgs: {3. 4} executeMethod: (TestObjectForMethod new xxxMethod: thisContext homeMethod)]) debug">Objects as Methods</a> and <a href="code://&#13;self halt: &apos;Debug this and step until the DoIt is about to return! &#13;What will #ifTrue:ifFalse: return do when sent to a non-boolean object?&apos;.&#13;x := &apos;not a boolean&apos; ifTrue: [&apos;it&apos;&apos;s true-ish&apos;] ifFalse: [&apos;it&apos;&apos;s false-ish&apos;].&#13;x inspect">\#mustBeBoolean</a>, corrected simulation of a few <a href="code://InstructionStream&gt;&gt;#interpretSistaV1Jump">SistaV1 instruction types</a>, and fixed the <a href="code:// ToolSet browseVersionsOf: Context selector: #doPrimitive:method:receiver:args:">simulation</a> of <a href="code://&#13;#(&apos;perform primitives (83, 84, 100) for non-symbol selectors&apos; &apos;proper error codes for primitiveDoPrimitiveWithArgs (118)&apos; &apos;primitiveExecuteMethodArgsArray (188) for primitive methods&apos; &apos;previously missing simulation for primitiveExecuteMethod (189)&apos;) exploreWithLabel: &apos;primitive simulation fixes&apos;">various</a> <a href="code://&#13;ToolSet browseClass: ContextTest category: &apos;tests - simulation&apos;">control primitives</a>.
  - Adds support for <a href="code:// Process&gt;&gt;#effectiveProcess"><b>recursive process-faithful debugging</b></a>, thus making it possible not only to <a href="code://&#13;debugger := (Process forBlock: [Processor activeProcess isActiveProcess]) debugWithTitle: &apos;Debugger&apos;.&#13;(Process forBlock: [debugger stepInto]) debugWithTitle: &apos;Debugger on debugger&apos;.">debug a debugger</a> but also to <a href="code://&#13;debugger := (Process forBlock: [Processor activeProcess isActiveProcess]) debugWithTitle: &apos;Debugger&apos;.&#13;debugger2 := (Process forBlock: [debugger stepInto]) debugWithTitle: &apos;Debugger on debugger&apos;.&#13;(Process forBlock: [debugger stepOver]) debugWithTitle: &apos;Debugger on debugger on debugger&apos;.">debug a debugger which is debugging a third debugger</a>.
  - Signals a new <a href="code://SimulationSideEffectWarning">SimulationSideEffectWarning</a> before simulating certain primitives to allow clients such as debuggers to control the scope of simulation.
  - Fixes the debugger when stepping through a <a href="code://&#13;| p |&#13;p := Process forContext: ([[] ensure: []] asContext) priority: 40.&#13;p debug. &apos;step through #ensure:&apos;">dead home context</a>.
- <b>Processes &amp; scheduling:</b>
  - Improves and better documents <a href="code://Process&gt;&gt;#terminate">process termination</a> and <a href="code://Context&gt;&gt;#unwindAndResume:evaluating:">stack unwinding</a> for several edge cases, making <a href="code://ToolSet browseClass: ProcessTest category: &apos;tests&apos;">repeated termination</a> of halfway-unwound processes and debugging in concurrent settings more reliable. Improves stepping and closing a debugger while the debugged process is <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openMonticelloVersion: &apos;Kernel-jar.1500&apos;">suspended</a>, <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openMonticelloVersion: &apos;Kernel-jar.1501&apos;">blocked</a>, performing a <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openMonticelloVersion: &apos;Kernel-jar.1503&apos;">non-local return</a>, or even about to <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openMonticelloVersion: &apos;Kernel-jar.1539&apos;">resume</a> from a BlockCannotReturn exception.
  - Prevents <a href="code:// Process&gt;&gt;#destroy">Process&gt;&gt;destroy</a> from crashing the entire VM when sent to a blocked process.
  - Fixes rescheduling after <a href="code://BlockClosure&gt;&gt;#valueAt:">BlockClosure&gt;&gt;valueAt:</a> and <a href="code://BlockClosure&gt;&gt;#valueUnpreemptively">BlockClosure&gt;&gt;valueUnpreemptively</a> by introducing a new primitive for <a href="code://Process&gt;&gt;#priority:">Process&gt;&gt;priority:</a>.
  - For threaded VMs, adds <a href="code://Process&gt;&gt;#isInExternalCode">Process&gt;&gt;isInExternalCode</a> to test whether a primitive is running in the background.
  - Makes it possible to <a href="code:// Delay&gt;&gt;#reset">reset</a> a scheduled Delay.
- <b>Promises:</b>
  - New <a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: Promise class category: &apos;waiting&apos;">helpers for combining promises</a> such as \#all:, \#anyOne:, and \#race:.
  - Adds and revises accessors for <a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: Promise category: &apos;waiting&apos;">awaiting</a> and <a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: Promise category: &apos;testing&apos;">testing</a> promises. <a href="code:// Promise&gt;&gt;#value">Promise&gt;&gt;value</a> is now a synonym of <a href="code:// Promise&gt;&gt;#wait">\#wait</a>; if the promise rejects, both no longer wrap the error into a BrokenPromise but re-raise it directly (see <b>Major deprecations</b> below). Accelerates waiting for already resolved promises.
  - Does not prematurely fail a promise when its resolution <a href="code:// Project uiManager edit: &apos;World future halt then: #inspect&apos; label: &apos;Example with breakpoint in promise chain&apos; shouldStyle: true">triggers</a> a breakpoint or signals a (resumable) <a href="code:// Notification">Notification</a>.
- <b>Methods, context, and block closures:</b>
  - Adjusts further accessors and queries for the new SistaV1 bytecode set and full block closures. Cleans up vocabulary on BlockClosure and Context for accessing <a href="code:// Context&gt;&gt;#home">home contexts</a> and <a href="code:// FullBlockClosure&gt;&gt;#homeMethod">methods</a>.
  - For Sista, allows creating classes with up to <a href="code:// Behavior&gt;&gt;#maxInstSize">64k instance variables</a>.
  - Fixes different <a href="code:// self systemNavigation browseMessageList: {&apos;CompiledCode hasInstVarRef&apos;. &apos;CompiledCode hasMethodReturn&apos;} name: &apos;Fixed instruction tests for Sista&apos;">instruction tests</a>.
  - Speeds up <a href="code:// self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;CompiledCode sendsToSuper&apos; &apos;CompiledMethod readsField:&apos; &apos;CompiledMethod writesField:&apos;) name: &apos;Accelerated literal enumeration methods&apos;">bytecode</a>/<a href="code:// CompiledCode&gt;&gt;#allLiteralsDo:scanForSpecial:">literal</a> enumeration for faster SystemNavigation queries.
  - Improves method symbolic text through <a href="code:// (CompiledCode&gt;&gt;#symbolicText) browse toggleShowingByteCodes">colorful styling</a> and by labeling <a href="code:// (Context&gt;&gt;#isClosureContext) browse toggleShowingByteCodes">instance variable references</a>.
  - Makes <a href="code://TextLink new classAndMethod: &apos;CompiledCode =&apos;; actOnClickFor: Model new">CompiledCode equality</a> invariant under the caches used for <a href="code:// String&gt;&gt;#translated">internationalization</a> and <a href="code://BlockClosure&gt;&gt;#once">BlockClosure&gt;&gt;once</a>. Improves <a href="code:// CompiledMethod&gt;&gt;#dateMethodLastSubmitted">parsing</a> of method timestamps.
  - Allows constructing <a href="code:// MessageSend">MessageSends</a> without a receiver and extends their accessing/conversion/testing protocols. Improves polymorphism with <a href="code://WeakMessageSend">WeakMessageSend</a>.
  - Speeds up enumeration of <a href="code:// CompiledMethod&gt;&gt;#pragmasDo:">pragmas</a> and <a href="code:// CompiledMethod&gt;&gt;#anyAndAllSelectorsDo:">selectors</a> by 20%.
- <b>Classes and organizers:</b>
  - Speeds up <a href="code:// ClassBuilder">class (re-)building</a> by more than 30% by using the MethodMassage package (see below).
  - Improves overall reliability of <a href="code:// [ChangeList browseRecentLog] valueSupplyingAnswer: 1. nil">source logging</a> after correcting a syntax error and when recategorizing classes, removing class variables, or changing class comments.
  - Automatically <a href="code:// PackageInfo class&gt;&gt;#sanitizeName:">sanitizes</a> category and package names by removing leading/trailing spaces. Adds conveniences <a href="code:// Categorizer&gt;&gt;#includesCategory:">Categorizer&gt;&gt;includesCategory:</a> and <a href="code:// Categorizer&gt;&gt;#classifyAll:under:suppressIfDefault:">\#classifyAll:under:suppressIfDefault:</a>. Renames <a href="code:// ClassDescription&gt;&gt;#allMethodsInCategory:">ClassDescription&gt;&gt;</a>[<a href="code:// ClassDescription&gt;&gt;#allMethodsInCategory:">all</a>]<a href="code:// ClassDescription&gt;&gt;#methodsInCategory:">MethodsInCategory:</a> to <a href="code:// ClassDescription&gt;&gt;#allSelectorsInCategory:">\#</a>[<a href="code:// ClassDescription&gt;&gt;#allSelectorsInCategory:">all</a>]<a href="code:// ClassDescription&gt;&gt;#selectorsInCategory:">SelectorsInCategory:</a>.
- Persists the preferences <a href="code:// SmalltalkImage&gt;&gt;#processPreemptionYields:">processPreemptionYields</a> and <a href="code:// (Preferences pragmaPreferenceFor: EventSensor getter: #mapControlKeysToCommandKeys) open">&quot;map control keys to command keys&quot;</a> across image restarts.
- Improves multilingual support in various places.
- Miscellaneous improvements to documentation of <a href="code://TextLink new classAndMethod: &apos;Process Comment&apos;; actOnClickFor: Model new">suspension/resumption points</a>, <a href="code://&#13;ToolSet browseMessageNames: &apos;unwindTo:&apos; , (Character value: 59) , &apos;unwindTo:safely:&apos;">stack unwinding</a>, and others.
- Miscellaneous improvements to test coverage, especially for <a href="code://ContextTest">simulation</a>, <a href="code://ProcessUnwindTest">unwinding</a>, and <a href="code://ProcessTest">process termination</a>.
- Overall clean-ups and refactorings. Work continues on improving modularization and avoiding <a href="code://DependencyBrowser openOnPackage: Object packageInfo">dependencies</a> from core packages on ST80, MorphicExtras, and EToys.

<i>Collections (up to </i>Collections-ct.1115/CollectionsTests-ct.419<i>)</i>
- Adds many new conveniences for enumerating, copying, and modifying <a href="code://&#13;self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;Collection withoutDuplicates&apos; &apos;Collection copyWithoutDuplicates&apos; &apos;SequenceableCollection findAll:&apos; &apos;SequenceableCollection findFirst:startingAt:&apos; &apos;SequenceableCollection groupsCollect:&apos; &apos;SequenceableCollection subsequences:&apos; &apos;SequenceableCollection with:select:&apos; &apos;SequenceableCollection withIndexSelect:&apos; &apos;RawBitsArray byteAt:&apos; &apos;RawBitsArray byteAt:put:&apos; &apos;RawBitsArray reverseEndianness&apos; &apos;ByteArray class newCryptographicallyRandom:&apos; &apos;RunArray intervalsAndValuesDo:&apos; &apos;Dictionary with:do:&apos; &apos;Dictionary with:collect:&apos; &apos;Dictionary withKeysValuesAnd:do:&apos; &apos;Dictionary withKeysValuesAnd:collect:&apos; &apos;Matrix @&apos;) name: &apos;New methods in collection hierarchy&apos;"><b>collections</b></a><b> and </b><a href="code://&#13;self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;PositionableStream peek:&apos; &apos;Stream isTextStream&apos; &apos;SharedQueue2 atEnd&apos; &apos;SharedQueue2 nextTimeout:&apos;) name: &apos;New methods in Stream hierarchy&apos;"><b>streams</b></a> (click to browse them all!). Improves <a href="code:// Collection&gt;&gt;#adaptToCollection:andSend:"><b>weak typing</b></a> between magnitudes and dictionaries so that arithmetic can be applied to dictionaries (<a href="code:// SqueakReleaseNotes openWorkspaceExample: #examplesDictionariesWeakTyping title: &apos;Weak typing with dictionaries&apos; shouldStyle: true">click here for examples!</a>).
- Introduces <a href="code:// ToolSet browseMessageNames: &apos;sortedFirst;sortedLast&apos;">AlternativeSortFunction</a> for sorting collections based on binary predicates.
- Adds new <b>string conveniences</b> for <a href="code:// ToolSet browseMessageNames: &apos;beginsWith*&apos; , (Character value: 59) , &apos;endsWith*&apos;">prefix/suffix testing</a>, <a href="code:// self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;String escapeQuote:&apos; &apos;String unescapeQuote:&apos;) name: &apos;New string methods for escaping/unescaping&apos;">escaping</a>, and <a href="code:// self systemNavigation browseAllImplementorsOfList: #(indexCorrespondingToLine:character: indicesCorrespondingToLine: lineCorrespondingToIndex:) title: &apos;Methods for index-to-row/col conversion&apos;">index-to-row/column conversion</a>.
- Improves printStrings and object explorer representations of <a href="code://&#13;(Collection packageInfo classes collect: #superclass as: Bag) inspect">bags</a> and <a href="code:// (Collection packageInfo classes collect: #superclass as: Set) explore">sets</a>, <a href="code://(HashedCollection withAllSubclasses collect: [:ea | ea -&gt; ea superclass] as: Dictionary) inspect">dictionaries</a> and <a href="code://(#(one three three three two two three three three) as: RunArray) explore">run arrays</a>, <a href="code://&apos;i &lt;3 squeak&apos; explore">strings</a> and <a href="code://$S explore">characters</a>. Adds <a href="code:// (Inspector openOn: SqueakReleaseNotes v61 contents) model selectFieldNamed: &apos;text&apos;">preview of formatted texts</a> to object inspectors.
- <b>Texts:</b> Adds <a href="code:// SqueakReleaseNotes openBrowser: (SystemBrowser default fullOnClass: Text) filterMessages: &apos;back&apos;">\#addAttributeBack:\*</a> for adding new attributes beneath existing attributes and fixes <a href="code://TextStream&gt;&gt;#withAttribute:do:">TextStream&gt;&gt;withAttribute</a>[<a href="code://TextStream&gt;&gt;#withAttributes:do:">s</a>]<a href="code://TextStream&gt;&gt;#withAttribute:do:">:do:</a> to preserve existing dominating attributes. Adds conveniences for <a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: Text category: &apos;testing&apos;">testing texts for attributes</a> and <a href="code:// self systemNavigation browseAllImplementorsOf: #asPlainText">converting them to plain text</a>. Improves <a href="code:// self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;Text class empty&apos; &apos;Text findString:&apos; &apos;Text lines&apos; &apos;Text withoutTrailingBlanks&apos; &apos;Text sameAs:&apos; &apos;Text withBlanksTrimmed&apos; &apos;Text withoutLeadingBlanks&apos;) name: &apos;String messages that are now also understood by texts&apos;">polymorphism</a> of texts with strings.
- Improves <b>HTML parsing</b> so that it now can correctly process most clipboard contents and rich-text emails (see below):
  - Makes it possible to <a href="code:// HtmlReadWriter&gt;&gt;#defaultPermissions">block downloads or execution</a> of untrusted HTML resources.
  - Adds <a href="code://HtmlReadWriter&gt;&gt;#mapBlockquoteTag">support for &lt;blockquote&gt;</a>.
  - Revises <a href="code://HtmlReadWriter&gt;&gt;#breakLines:">whitespace handling</a> for tags such as &lt;p&gt;, &lt;div&gt;, and &lt;pre&gt;.
  - Properly ignores <a href="code:// HtmlReadWriter&gt;&gt;#excludedTags">non-textual elements</a> such as &lt;script&gt; and &lt;style&gt; tags.
  - Improves robustness for parsing <a href="code://HtmlReadWriter&gt;&gt;#voidTags">HTML5 void tags</a>, redundant closing tags, and <a href="code://HtmlReadWriterTest&gt;&gt;#test13SpanTag">invalid/unsupported CSS properties</a>.
  - Fixes escaping/unescaping of special characters in <a href="code:// self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;String escapeEntities&apos; &apos;String asHtml&apos; &apos;String asUnHtml&apos; &apos;HtmlReadWriter htmlEscape:&apos; &apos;HtmlReadWriter writeContent:&apos;) name: &apos;Fixed HTML/XML entities (un)escaping&apos;">HTML/XML entities</a> and <a href="code:// ToolSet browseMethodVersion: TextURL&gt;&gt;#openHtmlOn:">URLs</a>. 
- Adds support for <a href="code:// ToolSet browseMessageNames: &apos;base32&apos;">base32 encoding/decoding</a>.
- Adds <a href="code:// Object&gt;&gt;#isAssociation">Object&gt;&gt;isAssociation</a>.
- Miscellaneous performance improvements for <a href="code:// SequenceableCollection&gt;&gt;#atAllPut:">sequenceable collection accessing</a>, <a href="code://LinkedList&gt;&gt;#with:collect:">linked list enumeration</a>, RunArray <a href="code://RunArray&gt;&gt;#findAll:">accessing</a> and <a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: RunArray category: &apos;sorting&apos;">sorting</a>, <a href="code:// (MCRepository trunk versionNamed: &apos;Collections-ul.1102.mcz&apos;) open">string substitution</a> and <a href="code:// String&gt;&gt;#substrings">tokenization</a>, <a href="code:// self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;Text addAllAttributes:&apos; &apos;Text addAllAttributes:from:to:&apos; &apos;TextStream withAttributes:do:&apos;) name: &apos;Accelerated text formatting methods&apos;">text formatting</a>, and <a href="code://Character&gt;&gt;#printOn:">character printing</a>.
- Several bug fixes for <a href="code:// ToolSet browseMethodVersion: RawBitsArray&gt;&gt;#byteAt:put:">RawBitsArray accessing</a>, <a href="code:// ToolSet browseMethodVersion: Matrix&gt;&gt;#with:do:">matrix enumeration</a>, <a href="code:// self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;ReadStream reset&apos; &apos;WriteStream reset&apos;) name: &apos;Fixed stream resetting methods&apos;">stream resetting</a> and <a href="code:// ToolSet browseMethodVersion: PositionableStream&gt;&gt;#isBinary">binary streaming</a>, and <a href="code:// ToolSet browseMethodVersion: HashedCollection&gt;&gt;#comeFullyUpOnReload:">filing in of hashed collections</a>. Enhances accuracy of <a href="code:// ToolSet browseMethodVersion: String&gt;&gt;#findSelector">String&gt;&gt;findSelector heuristics</a> (used by [CMD] + [N] for &quot;senders of it&quot; et al.) by trying to reuse the actual Smalltalk parser first. Improves hashing, copying, and comparing of <a href="code://TextAttribute">text attributes</a> and <a href="code://SortFunction">sort functions</a>.
- Improves multilingual support in several places. Switches <a href="code:// Collection&gt;&gt;#asCommaStringAnd">\#asCommaStringAnd</a> to use the Oxford comma.
- Overall clean-ups, refactorings, and <a href="code://TextLink new classAndMethod: &apos;WeakIdentityDictionary Comment&apos;; actOnClickFor: Model new">documentation</a> <a href="code://TextLink new classAndMethod: &apos;Text Comment&apos;; actOnClickFor: Model new">improvements</a>.

<i>Chronology (up to </i>Chronology-Core-ct.98/Chronology-Tests-ct.40<i>)</i>
- <a href="code://TimeZone"><b>Refactors time zones</b></a><a href="code://TimeZone"> into an extensible class hierarchy</a> to enable the definition of DST-aware zones such as <a href="https://wiki.squeak.org/squeak/5644">TZ-Olson</a>.
- Restores ANSI compliance of <a href="code://DateAndTime&gt;&gt;#offset:">DateAndTime&gt;&gt;offset:</a> by answering an equivalent time instead of reinterpreting it in a different time zone. Adds <a href="code://DateAndTime&gt;&gt;#asLocalAt:">\#asLocalAt:</a> and <a href="code://DateAndTime&gt;&gt;#utcOffset:">\#utcOffset:</a> as compatibility synonyms of the old and new behavior.
- Repairs <a href="code://(Preferences pragmaPreferenceFor: Time getter: #useHighResClockForTiming) open">&quot;high-resolution clock for timing&quot; preference</a> and improves precision of <a href="code://Time class&gt;&gt;#nanosecondsToRunHighRes:">Time class&gt;&gt;nanosecondsToRunHighRes:</a> when the preference is enabled.
- Fixes a <a href="code://TestValueWithinFix&gt;&gt;#testValueWithinTermination">race condition</a> when terminating a process during <a href="code://BlockClosure&gt;&gt;#valueWithin:onTimeout:">BlockClosure&gt;&gt;valueWithin:onTimeout:</a>.
- Overall improvements to <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;DateAndTime asUTC&apos; &apos;DateAndTime makeUTC&apos; &apos;Timespan beCanonical&apos; &apos;TimeZone Comment&apos;) name: &apos;Improved Chronology documentation&apos;">documentation</a>. Adds <a href="code:// (Inspector openOn: Date today) model selectFieldNamed: &apos;month&apos;">convenient</a> <a href="code://(Inspector openOn: Time now) model selectFieldNamed: &apos;minute&apos;">accessor</a> <a href="code://DateAndTime today asWeek inspect">fields</a> to inspectors on chronology objects.

<i>Compiler (up to </i>Compiler-ct.535<i>)</i>
- Allows <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openWorkspaceExample: #examplesSendingPvtToSuper title: &apos;Sending pvt* to super&apos;"><b>sending \#pvt\* selectors to super</b></a>, thus making it possible to override and extend private methods in subclasses.
- <b>Parser warnings:</b>
  - Adds a new opt-in preference for <a href="code://(Preferences pragmaPreferenceFor: ShadowedVariableNotification getter: #enableInteractiveWarning) open">interactive warnings about variable shadowing</a> to replace classical transcript warnings.
  - Removes warnings about <a href="code://UndefinedVariable&gt;&gt;#openMenuIn:">undefined temporary variables</a> when they are being sent a <a href="code://Parser&gt;&gt;#primaryExpression">nil check</a>.
  - Adds missing warning about <a href="code:// Project uiManager edit: &apos;1 §§§§ 222&apos; label: &apos;Example&apos; shouldStyle: true">unknown binary selectors</a>, analogously to warnings about unknown unary and keyword selectors.
- <b>Improves handling of comments</b> in the parse tree by always assigning them to the nearest expression or statement and printing nodes with comments more reliably. Adds new preference to control <a href="code:// (Preferences pragmaPreferenceFor: ParseNode getter: #prefPrettyPrintCommentWidthInPoints) open">hard-wrapping comments during pretty-printing</a>, which is now disabled by default.
- <b>Records </b><a href="code://MethodNode&gt;&gt;#rawSourceRanges"><b>source ranges</b></a><b> for variables</b> by introducing <a href="code://VariableUsageNode">VariableUsageNode</a> to benefit selection in the debugger and source localization for other AST users.
- Avoids <a href="code://Symbol class&gt;&gt;#intern:">side-effects on symbol </a><a href="code://Symbol class&gt;&gt;#intern:"><u>tables</u></a> during parsing by signaling new <a href="code://UnknownSymbolNotification">UnknownSymbolNotification</a> that cautious clients can handle before a new symbol is created.
- Moves Compiler class&gt;&gt;<a href="code:// self systemNavigation &#13;			methodHierarchyBrowserForClass: Behavior&#13;			selector: #parserClass">parserClass</a> to <a href="code:// self systemNavigation &#13;			methodHierarchyBrowserForClass: Compiler&#13;			selector: #preferredParserClass&#13;">Compiler class&gt;&gt;preferredParserClass</a>.
- Fixes several parser bugs regarding pragmas (<a href="code://Parser&gt;&gt;#parseArgsAndTemps:">pragmas before temporaries</a>, <a href="code://Parser&gt;&gt;#simulationGuard">unary pragma parsers</a>), <a href="code://Parser&gt;&gt;#parseParameterNames:">handling underscore selectors</a>, parsing <a href="code://String&gt;&gt;#findLiteral">standalone literals</a>, and <a href="code://(MCRepository trunk versionNamed: &apos;Compiler-pre.493.mcz&apos;) open">compiling future sends</a>. Corrects slips during encoding and decompiling of <a href="code://EncoderForSistaV1 class&gt;&gt;#isReturnTopFromMethodAt:in:">Sista-specific</a> <a href="code:// (MCRepository trunk versionNamed: &apos;Compiler-eem.483.mcz&apos;) open">instructions</a> and <a href="code://Decompiler&gt;&gt;#pushFullClosure:numCopied:">full blocks</a>.
- Adds a <a href="code:// BytecodeEncoder class&gt;&gt;#condensedFrequencyTable">utility</a> to compute static bytecode frequencies.
- Miscellaneous <a href="code://&#13;self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;EncoderForV3 class isSendAt:in:&apos; &apos;EncoderForSistaV1 Definition&apos; &apos;BraceNode Comment&apos; &#13;&apos;CompilationCue Comment&apos;) name: &apos;Documentation improvements in Compiler package&apos;">documentation improvements</a>.

<i>Environments (up to </i>Environments-ct.88<i>)</i>
- Adds <a href="code://Object&gt;&gt;#isEnvironment">Object&gt;&gt;isEnvironment</a>.
- Speeds up <a href="code://Environment&gt;&gt;#classOrTraitNamed:">Environment&gt;&gt;classOrTraitNamed:</a>.

<i>PackageInfo (up to </i>PackageInfo-ct.81<i>)</i>
- Automatically <a href="code:// PackageInfo class&gt;&gt;#sanitizeName:">sanitizes</a> package names by removing leading/trailing spaces.
- Improves <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openMonticelloVersion: &apos;PackageInfo-Base-ct.81&apos;">multi-environment support</a> when accessing classes of a package.
- Accelerates <a href="code:// ToolSet browseMethodVersion: PackageOrganizer&gt;&gt;#packageOfMethodCategory:ofClass:ifNone:">package-from-method lookup</a>, speeding up Monticello snapshots by up to 400%.

<i>Traits (up to </i>Traits-ct.320<i>)</i>
- Adds <a href="code://ClassDescription class&gt;&gt;#newTraitTemplateIn:composition:">trait templates with composition</a>.
- Improves <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openMonticelloVersion: &apos;Traits-ct.320&apos;">multi-environment support</a>, so one can define and access traits in other environments correctly.
- Minor refactorings, in particular, <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseAllCallsOn: #AssemblerMethod localToPackage: Trait packageInfo">uses</a> new MethodMassage package for compiling traits.

<i>MethodMassage (up to </i>MethodMassage-ct.75<i>)</i>  
Welcomes the <a href="code://AssemblerMethod packageInfo browse"><b>MethodMassage package</b></a> in the trunk, which makes it convenient to <a href="code://CompiledMethod&gt;&gt;#disassemble">disassemble</a> compiled methods as <a href="code://AssemblerMethod">first-class objects</a> with <a href="code:// | tree |&#13;tree := ((ToolSet explore: (AssemblerMethod&gt;&gt;#labelNameFor:) disassemble)&#13;	findA: PluggableTreeMorph) ifNil: [^self].&#13;tree items detect: [:ea | (ea contentsAtColumn: 1) = &apos;instructions&apos;] ifFound: #expand.&#13;tree containingWindow extent: 500px@300px.">reified labels</a>, inspect and rewrite them, and <a href="code://AssemblerMethod&gt;&gt;#assemble">reassemble</a> them. Previously, MethodMassage was developed and tested in the <a href="https://wiki.squeak.org/squeak/vmmaker">VMMaker repository</a> for at least 10 years. Recent changes to the package include <a href="code://AssemblerMethod&gt;&gt;#reshapeUsing:oldVars:">instance variable remapping</a> to support class reshaping in the trunk, improved documentation and test coverage, several performance improvements, and <a href="code://MethodMassageTests">full support</a> for the V3PlusClosures bytecode set alongside SistaV1.


<b><font color="#808080">~~~ Graphics &amp; Sound ~~~</font></b>

<i>Graphics (up to </i>Graphics-nice.562<i>)</i>
- Adds support for <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openWorkspaceExample: #examplesCSSColors title: &apos;CSS colors&apos;">basic CSS color functions</a> to improve <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openWorkspaceExample: #examplesHTMLWithCSSColors title: &apos;HTML with CSS colors&apos;">HTML parsing</a>.
- Adds <a href="code://Form&gt;&gt;#dither:">dithering</a> for smoothly reducing the color depth of <a href="code://(((SystemWindow windowsIn: Project current world) at: 1 ifAbsent: [WatchMorph new]) imageForm dither: 4) openAsMorph.&#13;self flag: #doNotTest &quot;fixme&quot;">forms</a>.
- Adds <a href="code://ToolSet browseClass: DisplayScreen class category: &apos;host OS window&apos;">accessors</a> for screen dimensions of multiple monitors.
- Improves <a href="code:// AbstractFont&gt;&gt;#symbolSample">font preview</a> for symbol fonts.
- Fixes <a href="code:// Color mercury openAsMorph">Color mercury</a>, decoding of <a href="code:// self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;Color class colorFromPixelValue:depth:&apos; &apos;Form isTransparentAt:&apos;) name: &apos;Fixed pixel value decoders&apos;">transparent pixel values</a>, copying of <a href="code:// ToolSet browseMethodVersion: Form&gt;&gt;#copyWithColorsReducedTo:">forms</a> and <a href="code:// ToolSet browseMethodVersion: CursorWithMask&gt;&gt;#blankCopyOf:scaledBy:">cursors</a>, detection of missing glyphs in <a href="code:// StrikeFont&gt;&gt;#hasGlyphForCode:">strike fonts</a>, opening of <a href="code:// GIFReadWriter class">GIF files</a>, and loading of translucent <a href="code:// PNGReadWriter&gt;&gt;#processInterlaced">interlaced</a> PNG images.
- Several performance improvements for <a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: Form category: &apos;processing&apos;">form filtering</a>, <a href="code://Color&gt;&gt;#setRed8:green8:blue8:">color construction</a> and <a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: Color class category: &apos;named colors - crayons&apos;"><font color="#FF6060">c</font></a><a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: Color class category: &apos;named colors - crayons&apos;"><font color="#008000">r</font></a><a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: Color class category: &apos;named colors - crayons&apos;"><font color="#555555">a</font></a><a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: Color class category: &apos;named colors - crayons&apos;"><font color="#800000">y</font></a><a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: Color class category: &apos;named colors - crayons&apos;"><font color="#000080">o</font></a><a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: Color class category: &apos;named colors - crayons&apos;"><font color="#0080FF">n</font></a><a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: Color class category: &apos;named colors - crayons&apos;"><font color="#FFFF00"> </font></a><a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: Color class category: &apos;named colors - crayons&apos;"><font color="#808000">c</font></a><a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: Color class category: &apos;named colors - crayons&apos;"><font color="#AAAAAA">o</font></a><a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: Color class category: &apos;named colors - crayons&apos;"><font color="#004080">n</font></a><a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: Color class category: &apos;named colors - crayons&apos;"><font color="#333333">s</font></a><a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: Color class category: &apos;named colors - crayons&apos;"><font color="#808080">t</font></a><a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: Color class category: &apos;named colors - crayons&apos;"><font color="#AAAAAA">a</font></a><a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: Color class category: &apos;named colors - crayons&apos;"><font color="#555555">n</font></a><a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: Color class category: &apos;named colors - crayons&apos;"><font color="#804000">t</font></a><a href="code:// ToolSet browseClass: Color class category: &apos;named colors - crayons&apos;"><font color="#400080">s</font></a>,  <a href="code:// self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;Rectangle class encompassing:&apos; &apos;Rectangle class merging:&apos;) name: &apos;Sped up rectangle merging functions&apos;">rectangle merging</a>, <a href="code:// Number&gt;&gt;#px">\#px</a>, and <a href="code:// PNGReadWriter&gt;&gt;#processNextChunk">PNG reading</a>. Removes unused font data to save space.
- Miscellaneous improvements for multilingual support, documentation, and test coverage.
- Deprecates <a href="code://AnimatedGIFReadWriter">AnimatedGIFReadWriter</a> in favor of <a href="code://GIFReadWriter">GIFReadWriter</a>.

<i>Balloon (up to </i>Balloon-ct.36<i>)</i>
- Minor <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openMonticelloVersion: &apos;Balloon-eem.35&apos;">performance improvements</a>.
- Improves documentation of <a href="code://GradientFillStyle class">gradient fills</a>.

<i>TrueType (Fonts) (up to </i>TrueType-tpr.99<i>)</i>
- Fixes backward compatibility with fonts that only have a <a href="code://TTCharacterMappingTable&gt;&gt;#prepareFromUnicode">deprecated Unicode mapping table</a>.
- Adds <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseAllImplementorsOf: #collectAllGlyphs">utility</a> for exploring all glyphs of a font.

<i>Sound (up to </i>Sound-ct.102<i>)</i>
- Adds accessors for enumerating available <a href="code:// SqueakReleaseNotes openBrowser: (SystemBrowser default fullOnClass: SoundPlayer class category: &apos;accessing&apos;) filterMessages: &apos;player&apos;">sound player</a> and <a href="code:// SqueakReleaseNotes openBrowser: (SystemBrowser default fullOnClass: SoundRecorder class category: &apos;accessing&apos;) filterMessages: &apos;recorder&apos;">recorder</a> devices and setting the current device.
- Adds missing methods for <a href="code:// self systemNavigation &#13;			methodHierarchyBrowserForClass:  AbstractSound  &#13;			selector:  #stopGracefully &#13;">stopping composite sounds</a>.
- Adds a <a href="code:// SampledSound class&gt;&gt;#serviceLoadingAiff">file service</a> for reading AIFF files.
- Adds <a href="code:// | sound |&#13;sound := SampledSound exampleBach play.&#13;(Inspector openOn: sound)&#13;	model selectFieldNamed: &apos;duration&apos;.&#13;self flag: #doNotTest">convenient inspector fields</a> to sounds.
- Improves reliability of <a href="code://AbstractSound&gt;&gt;#storeSampleCount:bigEndian:on:">storing</a> sounds (fixes redundant trailing zeros and an endianness issue when storing on in-memory streams).
- Improves performance of <a href="code://StreamingMonoSound">StreamingMonoSound</a>.


<b><font color="#808080">~~~ Files &amp; Network ~~~</font></b>

<i>Files (up to </i>Files-mt.223<i>)</i>
- Adds a <a href="code://(Preferences pragmaPreferenceFor: SourceFileArray getter: #internalizeChanges) open">preference</a> for <b>caching the changes file </b><a href="code://ChangeLogStream"><b>in the image</b></a> instead of logging changes to disk. This complements <a href="code://(Preferences pragmaPreferenceFor: CompressedSources getter: #internalizeSources) open">existing support for caching the sources file</a> in the image (introduced in Squeak 6.0) and allows a Squeak image to run as a standalone file without further dependencies on the file system.
- Provides access to <a href="code://FileDirectory class&gt;&gt;#getenv:"><b>system environment variables</b></a> and the <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;FileDirectory class workingDirectory&apos; &apos;FileDirectory class workingDirectory:&apos;) name: &apos;Message list&apos;"><b>current working directory</b></a> of the VM.
