- On Linux/Unix platforms, adds support for <a href="code:// Project uiManager edit: &apos;UnixFileDirectory default fullNameFor: &apos;&apos;~/.profile&apos;&apos;&apos; label: &apos;Home directory path extension example&apos; shouldStyle: true">tilde (~) path expansion</a> to the home directory.
- Adds a file service for <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes exampleBrowseSourcesFileChanges">browsing </a><code><a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes exampleBrowseSourcesFileChanges">.sources</a></code><a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes exampleBrowseSourcesFileChanges"> files</a>.
- Improves reliability of <a href="code:// ToolSet browseMethodVersion: FileDirectory&gt;&gt;#directoryContentsFor:do:">listing directories</a> with some inaccessible entries, testing whether a <a href="code://FileDirectory&gt;&gt;#exists">directory exists</a>, calculating <a href="code://DirectoryEntry&gt;&gt;#creationDateAndTime">creation</a> and <a href="code://DirectoryEntry&gt;&gt;#modificationDateAndTime">modification times</a> of files.
- Improves error detection when <a href="code://ToolSet browseMethodVersion: FileStream class&gt;&gt;#detectFile:do:">opening a file</a> or <a href="code://ToolSet browseMethodVersion: FileDirectory&gt;&gt;#copyHere:">copying files</a>.
- Fixes <a href="code://FileDirectory&gt;&gt;#writeSourceCodeFrom:baseName:isSt:useHtml:">filing out</a> of methods or <a href="code://FileDirectory&gt;&gt;#nextNameFor:extension:">change sets</a> with a slash in their name.
- Improves performance when <a href="code://FileDirectory class&gt;&gt;#extensionFor:">parsing file names</a>, <a href="code://FileDirectory&gt;&gt;#exists">testing directory existence</a>, and <a href="code://StandardFileStream&gt;&gt;#readOnlyCopy">reopening a file in read-only mode</a>.
- Extends documentation on <a href="code://ToolSet browseClass: FileStream class category: &apos;instance creation&apos;">file opening</a>, <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;FileDirectory Comment&apos; &apos;FileDirectory primLookupEntryIn:index:&apos; &apos;FileDirectory primLookupEntryIn:name:&apos;) name: &apos;Extended documentation on long Windows file paths&apos;">long file paths on Windows</a>, and <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;DirectoryEntry creationDateAndTime&apos; &apos;DirectoryEntry modificationDateAndTime&apos;) name: &apos;Updated documentation of file creation/modification dates&apos;">creation/modification dates</a>.

<i>Compression (up to </i>Compression-ct.64<i>)</i>
- Fixes <a href="code://GZipReadStream class&gt;&gt;#fileReaderServicesForFile:suffix:">file service</a> for installing compressed change sets.

<i>Network (up to </i>Network-nice.289/NetworkTests-pre.80<i>)</i>
- Improves <a href="code://(Preferences pragmaPreferenceFor: NetNameResolver getter: #enableIPv6) open"><b>new network support for IPv6</b></a> and enables it by default. Extends object inspector and explorer representations of <a href="code://Socket newTCP explore">sockets and socket addresses</a>.
- Adds <a href="code:// self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;MailMessage class serviceViewMessage&apos; &apos;MailMessage class serviceExploreMessage&apos;) name: &apos;File services for mail messages&apos;">file services</a> for viewing and exploring EML files as mail messages.
- Improves <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;MailMessage bodyTextFormatted:showAttachments:&apos; &apos;MIMEDocument bodyTextFormatted:showAttachments:&apos; &apos;MIMEDocumentTest testBodyTextFormatted&apos;) name: &apos;Rendering of mail messages&apos;"><b>rendering of mail messages</b></a> that contain rich text or <a href="code://TextMessageLink">attachments</a> and adds support for <a href="code://TextLink new classAndMethod: &apos;MIMEContentRequest Comment&apos;; actOnClickFor: Model new">inline (cid) images</a>.
- Extends <b><a href="code://TextLink new classAndMethod: &apos;SMTPClient Hierarchy&apos;; actOnClickFor: Model new">SMTP client</a></b> with new commands (verify, quit) and features (CRLF injection detection, 8BITMIME support, proper handling of 421 responses).
- <a href="code:// | text matcher tool |&#13;text := ((HtmlReadWriter on: &apos;Network-ct.263: Fixes a slip in mail composition that produced invalid recipient addresses according to RFC-5321. Addresses must not contain leading or trailing spaces. Some SMTP servers (such as Gmail) refuse to send these message.&#13;&#13;Network-ct.268/NetworkTests-ct.65: Fixes parsing of multipart documents. As per RFC1341, the final separator can - or even should - be extended by two dashes.&#13;&#13;Network-ct.269: Adds support for ascdate/cdate format in MailMessage headers. While this is not covered by RFC822, some mboxes do contain this format, such as the older years of http://lists.squeakfoundation.org/pipermail/squeak-dev/. Also fixes offset of fallback time.&#13;&#13;Network-ct.275: Fixes serialization of base64-encoded documents.&#13;&#13;Network-mt.276/NetworkTests-mt.70: Fixes parsing of MIMEType parameters.&#13;&#13;Network-ct.279/NetworkTests-ct.74: Increases robustness of serializing incomplete MIMEDocuments. Some messages on squeak-dev contain incomplete multipart documents.!&#13;]style[(15 17 16 186 34 7 7 112 15 18 20 125 55 23 13 3 15 7 13 31 34 7 7 26 34 25 11 94)b,,Rcode://MailComposition&amp;gt;&amp;gt;#doSendMail;,,b,,Rcode://MIMEDocument class&amp;gt;&amp;gt;#parseParts:withSeparator:;,,b,,Rcode://MailMessage&amp;gt;&amp;gt;#timeFrom:;,,Rhttp://lists.squeakfoundation.org/pipermail/squeak-dev/;,,Rcode://MailMessage&amp;gt;&amp;gt;#time;,,b,,Rcode://MIMEDocument&amp;gt;&amp;gt;#asSendableBodyText;,,b,,Rcode://MIMEType class&amp;gt;&amp;gt;#fromMIMEString:;,,b,,Rcode://MIMEDocument&amp;gt;&amp;gt;#asSendableBodyText;,!&apos; readStream) breakLines: false; nextText) asString readStream nextChunkText.&#13;(matcher := &apos;(Network(Tests)?-[a-z]+\.\d+)&apos; asRegex) matchesIn: text do: [:match |&#13;	text addAttribute: (PluggableTextAttribute evalBlock: [(MCRepository trunk versionNamed: match asString , &apos;.mcz&apos;) open]) from: (matcher subBeginning: 1) first + 1 to: (matcher subEnd: 1) first].&#13;tool := ToolBuilder open: (Workspace new contents: text) label: &apos;MIME update log&apos;.&#13;ToolBuilder default class setBoundsForWindow: tool to: ((ToolBuilder default class getBoundsForWindow: tool) origin extent: 375px@475px)">Improves overall robustness and RFC compliance</a> (click for details!) of serializing and parsing MIME documents and mail messages.
- Implements case-insensitive comparison of <a href="code://MIMEType">MIME types</a> and case-insensitive <a href="code://MIMEType&gt;&gt;#parameterAt:">access</a> to parameters.
- Improves robustness of <a href="code://Socket&gt;&gt;#initializeSocketHandleUsing:">external-semaphore management</a> for sockets.
- Miscellaneous improvements to test coverage for MIME documents, MIME types, SMTP sending, and IPv6 sockets.
- Extends documentation for <a href="code://TextLink new classAndMethod: &apos;MIMEType Comment&apos;; actOnClickFor: Model new">MIMEType</a> and <a href="code://Socket class&gt;&gt;#ping:">socket utilities</a> and <a href="code://Socket class&gt;&gt;#ping:">examples</a>.
- Improves performance of <a href="code://SocketStream&gt;&gt;#next:into:startingAt:">socket streaming</a>.

<i>SqueakSSL (up to </i>SqueakSSL-Core-mt.36<i>/</i>SqueakSSL-Tests-ct.30<i>)</i>
- Updates <a href="code://SqueakSSLTest&gt;&gt;#expectedFailures">list of current known bugs</a> for SqueakSSL on Linux and macOS.

<i>WebClient (up to </i>WebClient-Core-ul.138/WebClient-Tests-nice.66<i>)</i>
- Allows web servers to <a href="code://WebServer&gt;&gt;#addService:action:methods:">process</a> OPTIONS requests manually. For instance, this is required to handle CORS preflight requests properly.
- Several improvements and updates to <a href="code://TextLink new classAndMethod: &apos;WebServerHelp Help&apos;; actOnClickFor: Model new">WebServer documentation</a>.
- Sunsets JSON parser in <a href="code://TextLink new classAndMethod: &apos;WebUtils class Definition&apos;; actOnClickFor: Model new">WebUtils</a> in favor of the <a href="code://Json">JSON package</a>.
- Improves robustness of <a href="code://WebMessage&gt;&gt;#chunkFrom:to:progress:">chunked transfer decoding</a> and fixes parsing of <a href="code://WebCookie&gt;&gt;#readExpiryFrom:">WebCookie expiries</a>.
- Speeds up <a href="code://WebUtils class&gt;&gt;#md5Digest:">MD5 computation</a> in WebUtils by up to 600%.

<i>JSON (up to </i>JSON-ul.68<i>)</i>
- Adds new <a href="code://Collection&gt;&gt;#jsonAtPath:ifLost:">utility</a> for navigating JSON-ish objects along paths.
- Miscellaneous fixes for parsing <a href="code://Json&gt;&gt;#readFromString:">excessive inputs</a> or <a href="code://JsonNumberParser&gt;&gt;#nextNumber:">negative zeros</a>, testing <a href="code://OrderedJsonObject&gt;&gt;#respondsTo:">key membership</a> of ordered JSON objects, <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseAllImplementorsOf: #at:ifAbsentPut: localToPackage: Json packageInfo">\#at:ifAbsentPut:</a>, and rendering JSON objects <a href="code://JsonTests&gt;&gt;#testWriteNonStringKey">with non-string keys</a>.

<i>XML (up to </i>XML-Explorer-eem.3<i>)</i>
- Fixes a <a href="code://ToolSet browseMethodVersion: XMLElement&gt;&gt;#asExplorerString">performance issue</a> when exploring huge XML documents.


<b><font color="#808080">~~~ System Services ~~~</font></b>

<i>System (up to </i>System-ct.1522<i>)</i>
- <b>Introduces </b><a href="code://Ephemeron"><b>ephemerons</b></a>, which support <b>instance-based </b><a href="code://FinalizationRegistry"><b>finalization</b></a>, a major improvement over the post-mortem finalization provided by WeakArrays. By using <a href="code://EphemeronIdentityDictionary">ephemeron identity dictionaries</a> instead of <a href="code://WeakIdentityKeyDictionary">weak identity dictionaries</a>, weak indirect cyclic dependencies can now be properly garbage-collected for the first time.
- <b>Revises </b><a href="code://ToolSet browseClassCommentOf: ExtendedClipboardInterface"><b>extended clipboard interfaces</b></a> and enables them <a href="code://Clipboard&gt;&gt;#clipboardText">by default</a>. With this change, <a href="code://&apos;&lt;b&gt;Do this:&lt;/b&gt; Switch to another application in your operating system such as web browser or a rich-text editor and copy some formatted text from it into the clipboard. Then come back and paste it here!&lt;br&gt;&#13;&lt;br&gt;&#13;&apos; asTextFromHtml edit">pasting rich text from the host system</a> is supported in all operating systems. <a href="code://ExtendedClipboardInterface&gt;&gt;#clipboardText:">Copying rich text</a> and <a href="code://ToolSet browseClass: ExtendedClipboardInterface category: &apos;general-api-add&apos;">copying</a>/<a href="code://ToolSet browseClass: ExtendedClipboardInterface category: &apos;general-api-read&apos;">pasting</a> other formats such as pictures is still experimental.
- Improves <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openDockingBarMenuThat: [:m | m contents = &apos;Extras&apos;] filterItem: &apos;Recover changes&apos;"><b>change recovery</b></a> by discovering class definitions and method removals in change records and parsing the selectors of do-its.
- <b>System navigation:</b>
  - Adds queries for browsing <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openBrowser: (SystemBrowser default fullOnClass: SystemNavigation) filterMessages: &apos;primitive&apos;">methods with primitives</a>, <a href="code://SystemNavigation&gt;&gt;#allPragmaSelectorsLocalToPackage:">pragmas in a package</a>, and methods or <a href="code://ToolSet browseMethodVersion: SystemOrganizer&gt;&gt;#superclassOrder:">classes</a> in categories containing a <a href="code://SystemNavigation&gt;&gt;#browseAllMethodsInCategoryToken:">token</a>.
  - Fixes queries for <a href="code://ToolSet browseMethodVersion: SystemNavigation&gt;&gt;#allCallsOn:and:localToPackage:">callers in package</a>, methods containing a <a href="code://ToolSet browseMethodVersion: SystemNavigation&gt;&gt;#allMethodsWithString:matchCase:">string</a>, and methods containing <a href="code://ToolSet browseMethodVersion: SystemNavigation&gt;&gt;#browseVariableReferences:">pool variables</a>, <a href="code://SystemNavigation&gt;&gt;#methodsWithUnboundGlobals">unbound globals</a>, or <a href="code://SystemNavigation&gt;&gt;#unusedBlocks">unused blocks</a>.
- Adds facilities for enumerating the <a href="code://SystemOrganizer&gt;&gt;#classNamesIn:">class names in a system category</a> and the <a href="code://ChangeSet class&gt;&gt;#scanClassCommentVersionsOf:">versions of a class comment</a>.
- Adds convenient accessors for <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;SmalltalkImage imageHeaderFlagAt:&apos; &apos;SmalltalkImage imageHeaderFlagAt:put:&apos;) name: &apos;Image header flag accessors&apos;">image header flags</a> such as <a href="code://SmalltalkImage&gt;&gt;#upscaleDisplayOnHighDPI">high-DPI support</a> and <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;SmalltalkImage processHasOSErrorInstVar&apos; &apos;SmalltalkImage processHasThreadAffinityInstVar&apos;) name: &apos;Image header flags for threaded VMs&apos;">threaded VMs</a>. Facilitates responding to platform changes after VM <a href="code://Behavior&gt;&gt;#startUp:">restarts</a> by <a href="code://SmalltalkImage&gt;&gt;#previousPlatformName">remembering</a> the previous platform name. Improves <a href="code://SmalltalkImage&gt;&gt;#isHeadless">detection</a> of headless mode.
- Adds support for <a href="code://TextDiffBuilder&gt;&gt;#buildStringPatch">plain-text diffing</a> to complement existing <a href="code://TextDiffBuilder&gt;&gt;#buildDisplayPatch">rich-text diffing</a>.
- Adds an optional preference for <a href="code://(Preferences pragmaPreferenceFor: RealEstateAgent getter: #rememberWindowExtent) open">reusing the size of tool windows</a>, which previously was available for debuggers only.
- For the <a href="code://Project tryEmergencyEvaluatorForRecovery: &apos;This is a dummy error.&apos;. Display restore.&#13;self flag: #doNotTest.">emergency mode REPL</a>, adds a <code>clear</code> command and improves high-DPI support.
- Miscellaneous UI improvements:
  - Adds syntax highlighting when <a href="code://ChangeSetBrowser openOnCurrent offerWindowMenu.&#13;(Project current world findA: MenuMorph) ifNotNil: [:m | m checkedMatchString: &apos;add&apos;]">editing</a> the preamble or postscript of a change set.
  - Revises the layout of the <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openDockingBarMenuThat: [:m | m contents = &apos;Extras&apos;] filterItem: &apos;annotation&apos;">annotation setup dialog</a>.
  - Automatically derives the <a href="code://Utilities class&gt;&gt;#authorName">full name of known authors</a> from their initials.
  - Revises <a href="code://ToolSet browseMethodVersion: RealEstateAgent class&gt;&gt;#assignCollapsePointFor:">algorithm for collapsing</a> more windows than fit in one column on the screen.
  - For projects, adds an accessor to set an <a href="code://Project&gt;&gt;#explicitName:">explicit name</a>.
  - Improves UI strings and multilingual support in several places.
  - Tunes syntax highlighting colors for the <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openDockingBarMenuThat: [:m | m contents = &apos;Extras&apos;] filterItem: &apos;theme&apos;">Community Dark</a> and <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openDockingBarMenuThat: [:m | m contents = &apos;Extras&apos;] filterItem: &apos;theme&apos;">Trim</a> themes.
- <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openMonticelloDiffFrom: &apos;System-mt.1381&apos; to: &apos;System-mt.1384&apos;">Refactors</a> debugger invocation and resumption for different GUI frameworks, making it easier to write and integrate a custom debugger. Introduces a <a href="code://DebuggerInvocationCue">debugger invocation cue</a> for passing along additional context such as an exception to the debugger.
- Refactors and fixes the <a href="code://ToolSet browseClassCommentOf: LowSpaceWatcher">low-space watcher</a> for Spur VMs and tunes thresholds to avoid premature redundant warnings.
- Miscellaneous fixes:
  - Makes <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openDockingBarMenuThat: [:m | m contents = &apos;Projects&apos;] filterItem: &apos;save&apos;">saving projects</a> more reliable and improves backward compatibility for <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openDockingBarMenuThat: [:m | m contents = &apos;Projects&apos;] filterItem: &apos;load&apos;">loading projects</a>/<a href="code://Morph class&gt;&gt;#serviceLoadMorphFromFile">morphs</a> from older image versions.
  - For change files, improves multi-environment during <a href="code://ChangeRecord&gt;&gt;#fileIn">fileIn</a>/<a href="code://SystemOrganizer&gt;&gt;#fileOut">Out</a>, browsing of <a href="code://PseudoClass">file-out classes</a>, checking removed classes in a change set for <a href="code://ChangeSet&gt;&gt;#checkForSlips">slips</a>, and <a href="code://SmalltalkImage&gt;&gt;#condenseSources">condensing</a> into new <code>.sources</code> files.
  - Makes canceling <a href="code://AppRegistry class&gt;&gt;#default">default app</a> dialogs safer and allows providing empty credentials for mail senders.
  - Improves high-DPI support for window placement.
  - Improves headless support for <a href="code://DoItFirst&gt;&gt;#doIt:">print-its</a>, <a href="code://ToolSet browseMethodVersion: CodeLoader&gt;&gt;#installSourceFile:">syntax errors</a>, and <a href="code://SmalltalkImage&gt;&gt;#run:">interactive dialogs</a>.
- Noteworthy optimizations for <a href="https://lists.squeakfoundation.org/archives/list/squeak-dev%40lists.squeakfoundation.org/thread/Y2PRZLFEWSFKATITDM7PP2A6WB5XEG7Z/">user interface theme requests (speeds up typical tool building by ~50%)</a>, <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openDockingBarMenuThat: [:m | m contents = &apos;Windows&apos;] filterItem: &apos;collapse all&apos;">window collapsing</a>, <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openDockingBarMenuThat: [:m | ([m wordingSelector] onDNU: #wordingSelector do: [nil]) = #browseChangesLabel] filterItem: nil">changes enumeration</a>, and <a href="code://SpaceTally">space tallies</a>.
- Improves documentation of several interfaces such as <a href="code://SystemNavigation">system navigation queries</a>, <a href="code://SmalltalkImage&gt;&gt;#vmParameterAt:">VM parameters</a>, and others.
- Cleans up unused preferences and project parameters.

<i>Regex (up to </i>Regex-Core-ct.93/Regex-Tests-Core-ct.38<i>)</i>
- Adds <b>new support</b> for <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;RxParserTest testCodePointu&apos; &apos;RxParserTest testCodePointx&apos;) name: &apos;Regex Unicode literals&apos;">Unicode literals</a> (<code><a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openWorkspaceExample: #examplesRegexHexEscape title: &apos;Regex hex escape examples&apos;">\x41</a></code>, <code><a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openWorkspaceExample: #examplesRegexUnicodeEscape title: &apos;Unicode escape examples&apos;">\u{1F388}</a></code>) and <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;RxParserTest testCharacterSetWithEscapedCharacters&apos; &apos;RxParserTest testUnicodeCategory&apos;) name: &apos;Character class escapes&apos;">character class escapes</a> (<code><a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openWorkspaceExample: #examplesRegexCharacterClass title: &apos;Regex character class examples&apos;">\p{N}, \P{Lu}</a></code>), <a href="code://ToolSet browseMessageNames: &apos;keyedSubexpression&apos;">named capturing groups</a> (<code><a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openWorkspaceExample: #examplesRegexNamedCaptureGroup title: &apos;Named capture group examples&apos;">(?&lt;num&gt;\d+)/(?&apos;den&apos;\d+)</a></code>), and <a href="code://RxMatcherTest&gt;&gt;#testNonCapturingGroup">non-capturing groups</a> (<code><a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openWorkspaceExample: #examplesRegexNonCapturingGroup title: &apos;Non-capturing group example&apos;">(?:ab)+</a></code>). Allows <a href="code://self systemNavigation &#13;			methodHierarchyBrowserForClass: RxsNode&#13;			selector:  #isNullable &#13;">nullable closures</a> to be repeated (<code><a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openWorkspaceExample: #examplesRegexNullableClosure title: &apos;Nullable closure example&apos;">(a|b*)?</a></code>).
- Adds support for <b>leftmost-longest matching</b> (POSIX style) through an optional <a href="code://RxMatcher&gt;&gt;#matchLongest:">flag</a>.
- Adds <a href="code://String&gt;&gt;#escapeForRegex">utility</a> to escape strings for use in regular expressions.
- Adds <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;RxMatcher allSubexpressions&apos; &apos;RxMatcher subexpressionRanges:&apos; ) name: &apos;New capture group accessors&apos;">convenience selectors</a> for accessing captured groups.
- Makes \#asRegex <a href="code://RxMatcher&gt;&gt;#asRegex">idempotent</a> so methods that <a href="code://String&gt;&gt;#occurrencesOfRegex:">expect</a> a pattern string can also take a preconfigured matcher instead.
- Fixes several issues with parsing <a href="code://RxParserTest&gt;&gt;#testNestedQuantifiers">nested</a> or <a href="code://RxParserTest&gt;&gt;#testQuantifierSequence">repeated</a> quantifiers and <a href="code://RxParserTest&gt;&gt;#testLookaroundParser">lookaround-alike</a> patterns.
- Fixes incorrect order of <a href="code://RxMatcherTest&gt;&gt;#testCapturesWithinBranches">capture groups within branches</a> and removes redundant <a href="code://RxParserTest&gt;&gt;#testNoCapturingOfLookarounds">capturing of lookarounds</a>.
- Repairs broken <a href="code://UIManager&gt;&gt;#request:regex:">regex prompt dialog</a>.

<i>SystemReporter (up to </i>SystemReporter-eem.68<i>)</i>
- Updates <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openSystemReporterOnVMParameters">description</a> for Cog VM parameters and image-header flags.

<i>PreferenceBrowser (</i>up to PreferenceBrowser-codefrau.159<i>)</i>
- Improves robustness of preference wizard when adjusting settings for low performance.

<i>Additional packages:</i>
- <a href="code://PreferenceWizardMorph&gt;&gt;#installFFI"><b>FFI</b></a><b>:</b>
  - A <a href="https://doi.org/10.1145/3660829.3660846">threaded version</a> of the OpenSmalltalk VM that can run primitives and FFI callouts in the background is under development.
  - Improves FFI exception handling by offering a <a href="code:// SqueakReleaseNotes requireFFI: [(Smalltalk at: #ExternalFunction) class&gt;&gt;#setFFIExceptionHandlingMode:]">configurable exception handling mode</a>, adding support for PrimitiveError and ExceptionInFFICallError for <a href="code:// SqueakReleaseNotes requireFFI: [(Smalltalk at: #ExternalFunction) class&gt;&gt;#externalCallFailedWith:]">failed FFI callouts</a>, and adding a <a href="https://source.squeak.org/FFI/FFI-Kernel-eem.237.diff">new pragma for asynchronous error reporting</a> in ThreadedFFI.
  - Adds <a href="https://source.squeak.org/FFI/FFI-Kernel-eem.234.diff">support for varargs</a> (optional arguments) in C declarations.
  - Adds support for ARM64.
  - Several robustness improvements to the type framework, thread safety, and platform changes.
  - Adds more convenient <a href="code:// SqueakReleaseNotes requireFFI: [self systemNavigation browseAllImplementorsOfList: #(getComputerName getCurrentUserDomain)]">Win32 utils</a>.
  - Overall improvements to test coverage, documentation, and performance.
- <a href="code://PreferenceWizardMorph&gt;&gt;#installOSProcess"><b>OSProcess</b></a><b>:</b>
  - Enables buffered readers (such as PipeableOSProcess from companion package CommandShell) to stream over a very large input stream by implementing <a href="code:// SqueakReleaseNotes requireOSProcess: [(Smalltalk at: #ResettableBufferStream)&gt;&gt;#pruneCollection]">automatic pruning</a>.
  - Adds support for Cuis and Unicode strings.
  - Sunsets support for the <a href="https://wiki.squeak.org/squeak/996">IOHandle</a> package, which is no longer maintained for recent versions of Squeak.
  - Overall stability and performance improvements.
- <a href="code:// PreferenceWizardMorph&gt;&gt;#installRefactoringTools">Refactoring tools</a>: Minor bug fixes, extensions, and performance improvements for refactoring rules.
- A new version of <a href="code:// SqueakReleaseNotes&#13;			openDockingBarMenuThat: [:m | m contents = &apos;Tools&apos;]&#13;			filterItem: &apos;Git Browser&apos;"><b>Squot</b></a> was <a href="https://github.com/hpi-swa/Squot/releases">released</a>, which adds support for <code>git revert</code>, tags, and co-authors, contains several UI improvements, and improves overall stability and performance.
- The first stable version of <a href="code:// (HelpBrowser openOn: SqueakContributionHelp) model showTopicNamed: #squeakInboxTalk"><b>Squeak Inbox Talk</b></a> was <a href="https://github.com/hpi-swa-lab/squeak-inbox-talk/releases/tag/v1.0">released</a>, which integrates the new HyperKitty archives for the Squeak mailing lists, adds support for rich-text messages and attachments (only available in the Squeak Trunk version), and contains several UI improvements.


<b><font color="#808080">~~~ Version Control &amp; Package Management ~~~</font></b>

<i>Installer (VersionNumber, UpdateStream, Squeak-Version) (up to </i>Installer-Core-ct.458/VersionNumber-eem.5<i>)</i>
- Adds support for <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;InstallerMonticello https:&apos; &apos;InstallerMonticello https:user:password:&apos;) name: &apos;HTTPs scheme&apos;">HTTPS schemes</a> to <a href="code://TextLink new classAndMethod: &apos;InstallerMonticello Definition&apos;; actOnClickFor: Model new">InstallerMonticello</a>. Uses HTTPS for <a href="https://source.squeak.org">source.squeak.org</a> and <a href="https://squeaksource.com">squeaksource.com</a>.
- <a href="code://MetacelloStub class&gt;&gt;#apiSelectors">Avoids</a> compiler and linter warnings when installing a Metacello package for the first time.
- Fixes a bug that polluted the current change set during the <a href="code://Installer class&gt;&gt;#ensureRecentMetacello">installation</a> of Metacello. Slightly accelerates installation.
- Fixes <a href="code://VersionNumber&gt;&gt;#&lt;">comparison</a> of version numbers with different lengths.
- Fixes multi-environment issue when <a href="code://#unloadCleanUp">unloading</a> packages via Monticello.

<i>Monticello (up to </i>Monticello-ct.822/MonticelloConfigurations-codefrau.187<i>)</i>
- <b>Adds &quot;file out theirs&quot;</b> to the patch list menu of code dialogs (such as when saving a version or <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes exampleMonticelloDiff">comparing two snapshots</a>).
- Makes <b>&quot;add (all) to current change set&quot;</b> in code dialogs capable of class and script definitions.
- Improves support for HTTPS repositories and enables <a href="code://MCMcmUpdater class&gt;&gt;#alternativeDescriptionOf:">migration</a> of existing HTTP repositories to HTTPS.
- Adds utility for <a href="code://MCWorkingCopyBrowser&gt;&gt;#eradicateRepository">eradicating</a> a repository from all working copies.
- Improves robustness of <a href="code://MCFileBasedRepository&gt;&gt;#versionNamed:">MCFileBasedRepository&gt;&gt;versionNamed:</a> by automatically appending a missing MCZ extension.
- Adds, improves, and fixes <a href="code://&#13; &apos;- When &lt;a href=&quot;code://SqueakReleaseNotes exampleMonticelloConfiguration&quot;&gt;browsing configurations&lt;/a&gt; in a repository, displays their metadata in the bottom pane.&lt;br&gt;&#13;- When &lt;a href=&quot;code://SqueakReleaseNotes exampleMonticelloVersion&quot;&gt;browsing versions&lt;/a&gt;, also displays the full name of the author.&lt;br&gt;&#13;- To the &lt;a href=&quot;code://SqueakReleaseNotes openDockingBarMenuThat: [:m | (m owner submorphIndexOf: m) = 1] filterItem: &amp;apos;update squeak&amp;apos;&quot;&gt;&amp;quot;update completed&amp;quot; dialog&lt;/a&gt;, adds a short reminder when a newer version of the OpenSmalltalk VM is available.&lt;br&gt;&#13;- Makes &amp;quot;update completed&amp;quot; dialog robust against unavailable CI information.&lt;br&gt;&#13;- &lt;a href=&quot;code://MCRepository&amp;gt;&amp;gt;#copyImageVersions&quot;&gt;Prevents&lt;/a&gt; accidental bulk copying of versions to trunk repositories.&lt;br&gt;&#13;- Improves confirmation message for &amp;quot;copy image versions here&amp;quot; from &lt;a href=&quot;code://MCWorkingCopyBrowser open. nil&quot;&gt;working copy browsers&lt;/a&gt;.&lt;br&gt;&#13;- Polishes and fixes &lt;a href=&quot;code://MCWorkingCopyBrowser&amp;gt;&amp;gt;#saveVersion&quot;&gt;several&lt;/a&gt; &lt;a href=&quot;code://MCWorkingCopyBrowser&amp;gt;&amp;gt;#flushCachedVersions&quot;&gt;other&lt;/a&gt; dialogs.&apos; asTextFromHtml edit">several dialogs</a>.
- Fixes loading of classes and trait definitions <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openMonticelloVersion: &apos;Monticello-mad.784&apos;">without comments</a>.
- Fixes <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openMonticelloVersion: &apos;Monticello-ct.820&apos;">multi-environment issues</a> when loading/unloading organization definitions.
- Fixes <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openMonticelloVersion: &apos;Monticello-eem.811&apos;">merging</a> and <a href="code://MCCodeTool&gt;&gt;#copyReference">&quot;copy reference&quot;</a> of removed definitions.
- Improves handling of <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseAllImplementorsOf: #acceptsLoggingOfCompilation">\#acceptsLoggingOfCompilation</a> while loading packages.
- Fixes <a href="code://MCPackageManager class&gt;&gt;#reregisterForNotificationsWith:">change detection</a> of working copies when renaming categories.
- Improves <a href="code://MCHttpRepository&gt;&gt;#webClientDo:">error reporting</a> when accessing HTTP repositories.

<i>SqueakMap (up to </i>SMBase-ct.147<i>/</i>SMLoader-ct.102<i>)</i>
- Fixes a bug when installing missing WebClient via SqueakMap.


<b><font color="#808080">~~~ Help &amp; Internationalization ~~~</font></b>

<i>GetText</i>
- No significant changes.

<i>Multilingual (up to </i>Multilingual-mt.293<i>)</i>
- Fixes a <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openMonticelloVersion: &apos;Multilingual-mt.290&apos;">bug</a> in UTF16 conversion for applying line-end conventions in little endian.
- Improves documentation on <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&apos;ByteArray utf8Decoded&apos; &apos;String utf8Encoded&apos;) name: &apos;UTF8 encoding/decoding&apos;">UTF8 encoding/decoding</a>.

<i>Help (up to </i>HelpSystem-Core-ct.159/Help-Squeak-Project-ct.105<i>)</i>
- <b>Help contents:</b>
  - <b>Adds a tutorial on </b><a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openDockingBarMenuThat: [:m | m contents = &apos;Help&apos;] filterItem: &apos;Contribut&apos;"><b>how to contribute to Squeak</b></a><b>.</b> Includes a short description of Squeak&apos;s community model, our development process, and recommended tools such as Monticello and Squeak Inbox Talk. It has never been easier to join the community - go ahead and make your first contribution NOW! :-)
  - <b>Updates </b><a href="code://(HelpBrowser openOn: SqueakTutorialsCommandKey) model showFirstTopic"><b>keyboard shortcut reference</b></a> with global shortcuts and shortcuts for windows, menus, lists, and trees as well as instructions to customize shortcuts.
  - Improves and updates several sections of the <a href="code://(HelpBrowser openOn: TerseGuideHelp) model showFirstTopic">terse guide</a>.
  - Minor clean-ups and improvements on various help topics. Updates <a href="code://(HelpBrowser openOn: SqueakProjectHelp) model showTopicNamed: #squeakResourcesOnline">collection of online resources</a>.
- Moves release notes (like this one!) <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes class">into the image</a>, which were previously managed on GitHub. They are <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes class&gt;&gt;#storeAsJekyllFilesInDirectoryNamed:">mirrored</a> to <a href="https://squeak.org/release_notes/">squeak.org/release\_notes/</a>, so you can view them and click on examples to run them in SqueakJS even if you have no image at hand (how dare you!).
- <b>Help system:</b>
  - <b>Expands support for </b><a href="code://(HelpBrowser openOn: HelpOnHelp) model showTopicNamed: #writingYourOwnHelp"><b>editing help through the help browser</b></a><b> without writing code.</b> Users can now manage custom help topics and file-based help topics by using the context menu in the tree view or dragging and dropping topics.
  - Revises icons in help browsers for empty help books, references of generic classes, and search results.
  - Refactors <a href="code://ToolSet browseMethodVersion: SearchTopic&gt;&gt;#startSearch">help search</a> and integrations for <a href="code://AbstractFileBasedHelpTopic">files/directories</a> and <a href="code://HtmlHelpTopic">HTML sites</a> into the help system. In <a href="code://DirectoryBasedHelpTopic">directory-based help topics</a>, now uses the same <a href="code://AbstractFileBasedHelpTopic&gt;&gt;#sortBlock:">sorting strategy</a> for child directories (recursively).
  - Stability improvements for browsing single styled topics, editing contents of directory topics, and searching topics.


<b><font color="#808080">~~~ Deployment &amp; Miscellaneous ~~~</font></b>

<i>Tests (up to </i>Tests-ct.522<i>)</i>
- There are now over <a href="code://TestRunner open">5800 tests</a> in this release that run in less than 3 minutes on our <a href="code:// ((TextURL new url: SystemVersion current ciStatusPageUrl) actOnClickFor: nil)">CI</a>.
- Improves precision and coverage of tests for DataStreams, <a href="code://UserInterfaceThemeTest&gt;&gt;#test01ImplementationHooks">UI themes</a>, and <a href="code://ToolSet browseMethodVersion: PackageDependencyTest&gt;&gt;#testPackage:dependsExactlyOn:">package dependencies</a>.
- Improves safety of <a href="code://&#13;&apos;Prevents CompilerExceptionsTest from touching the changes file.&#13;Cleans up temporary files in SoundTest.&#13;Cleans up temporary change sets in Monticello tests and avoids touching the current change set.&#13;Fixes image segment tests to not damage existing classes in the image.&#13;Disables broken testForceChangesToDiskRobustness on Linux to prevent VM crashes.&#13;Extracts smoke tests for installer, which could previously load outdated versions of several packages into your image, into a separate class that is opt-in via InstallerSmokeTest class&gt;&gt;#generateTests.&apos;&#13;	editWithLabel: &apos;Improved tests&apos;">several tests</a> that might have corrupted or crashed the image before.

<i>ReleaseBuilder (up to </i>ReleaseBuilder-mt.248<i>)</i>
- Minor improvements for setting preferences reproducibly when creating new release images.



<b>Major Deprecations</b> (up to 60Deprecated-ct.117/61Deprecated-ct.29)  
<i>Miscellaneous </i><a href="code://self systemNavigation browseAllExtensionMethodsOfPackage: &apos;61Deprecated&apos;"><i>minor deprecations</i></a><i> in different packages. We value backward compatibility and try to avoid breaking changes wherever possible (see </i><b><i>Compatibility Notes</i></b><i> below for exceptions). All non-private methods and classes that were removed during refactorings are preserved in the 61Deprecated package and signal a (</i><a href="code://(Preferences pragmaPreferenceFor: Deprecation getter: #showDeprecationWarnings) open"><i>suppressible</i></a><i>) deprecation warning when used.</i>
- As part of a debugger refactoring, project-specific debugger subclasses (MorphicDebugger and MVCDebugger) have been eliminated. Custom debuggers can now directly inherit from <a href="code://Debugger browseHierarchy. nil">Debugger</a> again.
- Deprecates <a href="code://BrokenPromise">BrokenPromise</a>: If a promise is rejected, <a href="code://Promise&gt;&gt;#wait">Promise&gt;&gt;wait</a> et al. will now resignal the original exception (or a generic error if the promise was rejected without an exception). If the 61Deprecated package is installed, you can still handle BrokenPromise, but it is no longer a subclass of Error. <i>Note that the decision to deprecate BrokenPromise is </i><a href="https://lists.squeakfoundation.org/archives/list/squeak-dev@lists.squeakfoundation.org/thread/BHBVRXIXUFGXDLIAFGLBBZ2LCX4OKYGD/"><i>tentative</i></a><i> and might be revised again.</i>
- Renames misleading <a href="code://Promise&gt;&gt;#error">Promise&gt;&gt;error</a> to <a href="code://Promise&gt;&gt;#errorValue">\#errorValue</a>.
- Renames <a href="code://ClassDescription&gt;&gt;#methodsInCategory:">ClassDescription&gt;&gt;</a>[<a href="code://ClassDescription&gt;&gt;#allMethodsInCategory:">all</a>]<a href="code://ClassDescription&gt;&gt;#methodsInCategory:">MethodsInCategory:</a> to <a href="code://ClassDescription&gt;&gt;#selectorsInCategory:">\#</a>[<a href="code://ClassDescription&gt;&gt;#allSelectorsInCategory:">all</a>]<a href="code://ClassDescription&gt;&gt;#selectorsInCategory:">SelectorsInCategory:</a> because they never answered code objects but always symbols.
- Deprecates <a href="code://SequenceableCollection&gt;&gt;#checkedAt:">SequenceableCollection&gt;&gt;checkedAt:</a> and <a href="code://SequenceableCollection&gt;&gt;#copyWithoutFirst">\#copyWithoutFirst</a>.

<b>Known Issues</b>
- <a href="https://github.com/squeak-smalltalk/squeak-object-memory/issues/92">Debugger notifiers raised from background processes may appear with a disabled &quot;Proceed&quot; button.</a> As a workaround, you can first click on &quot;Debug&quot; and then on &quot;Proceed&quot;.
- An issue with recursive process-faithful debugging may cause rare infinite loops when performing certain steps in a debugger. If you encounter this issue, please follow the steps advised <a href="https://lists.squeakfoundation.org/archives/list/squeak-dev%40lists.squeakfoundation.org/message/MVMCMAHYTI5OXY5R5CMP76AEPLT5TOIC/">here</a> and <a href="code://SqueakReleaseNotes openDockingBarMenuThat: [:m | m contents = &apos;Help&apos;] filterItem: &apos;feedback&apos;">send us a bug report</a> to reproduce the situation. :-)
- Regular expressions handle <a href="https://github.com/squeak-smalltalk/squeak-object-memory/issues/159">greedy patterns inside lookbehinds</a> incorrectly.
- Running an HTTPS server via SqueakSSL is currently <a href="code://SqueakSSLTest&gt;&gt;#expectedFailures">not working</a> on Linux and macOS.
- <a href="https://github.com/OpenSmalltalk/opensmalltalk-vm/issues/732">On Linux, the image may run out of file descriptors in certain situations.</a> This can manifest as recurring primitive failures from \#primGetPosition: or an unresponsive image. As a workaround, you can increase the number of allowed file descriptors using <code>ulimit -n</code>.
- On Linux when using Wayland, <a href="https://github.com/OpenSmalltalk/opensmalltalk-vm/issues/777">text morphs may loose their focus on every click</a> (a workaround is attached to the bug report).
- <i>Found another bug? Share it with us on </i><a href="http://bugs.squeak.org/"><i>http://bugs.squeak.org/</i></a>!<i> :-)</i>

<b>Compatibility Notes</b>
- <a href="code://Promise&gt;&gt;#value">Promise&gt;&gt;value</a> now waits for the receiver (previously, it returned nil instead until the receiver had resolved).
- <a href="code://Matrix&gt;&gt;#with:do:">Matrix&gt;&gt;with:do:</a>, <a href="code://Matrix&gt;&gt;#with:collect:">\#with:collect:</a>, and <a href="code://Matrix&gt;&gt;#with:inject:into:">\#with:inject:into:</a> no longer implicitly ignore size-mismatches between both matrices but signal a clear error in this case.
- <a href="code://Text&gt;&gt;#format:">Text&gt;&gt;format:</a> and <a href="code://TextStream&gt;&gt;#withAttribute:do:">TextStream&gt;&gt;withAttribute</a>[<a href="code://TextStream&gt;&gt;#withAttributes:do:">s</a>]<a href="code://TextStream&gt;&gt;#withAttribute:do:">:do:</a> now insert attributes from the last argument <a href="code://Text&gt;&gt;#addAllAttributesBack:from:to:">above</a> existing attributes instead of beneath them, e.g.:  

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Text streamContents: [:stream \|  
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;stream withAttributes: {TextColor blue. TextEmphasis bold} do:  
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;[stream nextPutAll: &apos;abc&apos;.  
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;stream withAttribute: TextColor red do:  
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;[stream nextPutAll: &apos;def&apos;]]].  
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&apos;hi {1}&apos; asText  
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;addAttribute: TextColor red;  
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;format: {&apos;name&apos; asText addAttribute: TextColor green}.
- <a href="code://DateAndTime&gt;&gt;#offset:">DateAndTime&gt;&gt;offset:</a> has been fixed for ANSI compliance and now answers an equivalent version of the receiver in a different time zone instead of reinterpreting the receiver in a different time zone. Use <a href="code://DateAndTime&gt;&gt;#asLocalAt:">\#asLocalAt:</a> for the old behavior or <a href="code://DateAndTime&gt;&gt;#utcOffset:">\#utcOffset:</a> to avoid cross-compatibility issues. 
- Regex: <a href="code://RxMatcher&gt;&gt;#subexpression:">Captured subexpression</a><a href="code://RxMatcher&gt;&gt;#subexpressions:">s</a> are now stored <a href="code://RxParserTest&gt;&gt;#testNoCapturingOfLookarounds">consistently</a> in left-to-right order (previously, captures in alternatives were ordered from right to left).
- When constructing menus, <a href="code://self systemNavigation browseMessageList: #(&quot;&apos;CustomMenu addList:&apos;&quot; &apos;MenuMorph addList:&apos; &apos;PluggableMenuSpec addList:&apos;) name: &apos;addList:&apos;">\#addList:</a> now interprets backslashes in help tuples as line breaks.
- Help system: The <a href="code://AbstractFileBasedHelpTopic&gt;&gt;#sortBlock">sortBlock</a> for <a href="code://FileBasedHelpTopic">FileBasedHelpTopic</a> and <a href="code://DirectoryBasedHelpTopic">DirectoryBasedHelpTopic</a> is now applied to directories as well and propagated recursively to subdirectory topics. See <a href="code://AbstractFileBasedHelpTopic&gt;&gt;#defaultSortBlock">AbstractFileBasedHelpTopic&gt;&gt;defaultSortBlock</a> for a possible implementation.
